entries.english: In Pose mode the arrow keys walk past bones whose bone collections are all hidden (Rigify MCH / DEF / ORG bones), to the nearest shown parent, child or sibling; a generated Rigify rig follows its controls' ORG hierarchy (upper_arm_fk.L Up = shoulder.L). Maya walks into hidden nodes: bones hidden one by one (H) are still walked into, and an armature with controller tags (Control > Tag As Controller) follows its controller hierarchy instead. Off: plain hierarchy
entries.suggested_chinese: 在姿态模式下，方向键会跳过所属骨骼集合全部隐藏的骨骼（例如 Rigify 的 MCH / DEF / ORG 骨骼），选择最近的可见父级、子级或同级骨骼。生成的 Rigify 绑定按控制器对应的 ORG 层次遍历（例如 upper_arm_fk.L Up = shoulder.L）。Maya 原本允许遍历到隐藏节点：本插件仍允许遍历到通过 H 单独隐藏的骨骼；带有控制器标签的骨架则按控制器层次遍历，对应“控制 > 标记为控制器”。关闭此选项时，按普通骨骼层次遍历。

entries.english: Drag a vertex or edge onto the target to merge them (Maya Target Weld). A selected vertex takes every selected vertex with it
entries.suggested_chinese: 将顶点或边拖到目标上进行合并，对应 Maya 目标焊接。拖动选定顶点时，会带动全部选定顶点。

entries.english: Crease the selected edges (vertices in vertex mode): middle-drag left = less, right = more (Maya Crease Tool)
entries.suggested_chinese: 为选定边设置折痕；顶点模式下作用于顶点。鼠标中键向左拖动减小折痕，向右拖动增大，对应 Maya 折痕工具。

entries.english: Drag along edges to cut the UVs there, Ctrl+drag to sew them, Shift+drag to select edges. x = Cut, s = Sew, d = Unfold and Layout (Maya 3D Cut and Sew UV Tool)
entries.suggested_chinese: 沿边拖动剪切 UV，Ctrl + 拖动缝合，Shift + 拖动选择边。x 切换剪切，s 切换缝合，d 执行展开和布局，对应 Maya 三维剪切和缝合 UV 工具。

entries.english: Click edges, faces or vertices to place cut points, Enter or right-click to cut. Ctrl+click = edge loop, Shift = Snap Step %, Backspace = remove the last point, drag across faces = slice (Maya Multi-Cut)
entries.suggested_chinese: 单击边、面或顶点放置切割点，按 Enter 或单击右键执行切割。Ctrl+单击插入循环边，Shift 按“吸附步长百分比”吸附，Backspace 移除上一点，跨面拖动执行切片，对应 Maya 多切割。
剪切 / 插入循环边工具

entries.english: Drag: Cut  ·  Ctrl+drag: Sew  ·  Shift+drag: Select
entries.suggested_chinese: 拖动：剪切 · Ctrl + 拖动：缝合 · Shift + 拖动：选择

entries.draft_origin: 技术名称/代码/符号保留建议

entries.english: Click an edge to insert an edge loop at that point; drag before releasing to slide it (Maya Insert Edge Loop)
entries.suggested_chinese: 单击边，在该位置插入循环边；释放鼠标前拖动可滑移该循环边，对应 Maya“插入循环边”。

entries.english: Click an edge and drag: new edge loops on both sides of its edge loop (Maya Offset Edge Loop)
entries.suggested_chinese: 单击一条边并拖动，在其循环边两侧插入新循环边，对应 Maya“偏移循环边”。

entries.english: Select an edge loop or path, then middle-drag to slide it along the neighbouring edges (Maya Slide Edge)
entries.suggested_chinese: 选择循环边或边路径，然后拖动鼠标中键，沿相邻边滑移，对应 Maya“滑移边”。

entries.draft_origin: 本地 Blender 整句译文
本地相同整句（仅大小写/空白差异）

entries.english: Click on the live surface to place dots, Shift+click between them to fill a quad. Drag = move, Shift+drag = relax, Ctrl+click = edge loop, Ctrl+Shift+click = delete, Tab+drag = extend a border / quad strip (Maya Quad Draw)
entries.suggested_chinese: 在活动曲面上单击放置点，Shift + 单击点之间的区域填充四边面。拖动移动，Shift + 拖动松弛，Ctrl + 单击选择循环边，Ctrl + Shift + 单击删除，Tab + 拖动延伸边界或四边面带，对应 Maya 四边形绘制。

entries.english: Click to place points, Enter to make a new polygon object. Backspace removes the last point, middle-drag moves it (Maya Create Polygon)
entries.suggested_chinese: 单击放置点，按 Enter 创建新的多边形对象。Backspace 删除上一点，拖动鼠标中键移动该点，对应 Maya“创建多边形”。

entries.english: Click a border edge of the mesh, then place points or click another border edge; Enter adds the face (Maya Append to Polygon)
entries.suggested_chinese: 先单击网格边界边，再放置点或单击另一条边界边；按 Enter 添加面，对应 Maya“附加到多边形”。

entries.english: Maya marking menu: drag in a direction and release, flick, or click
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 标记菜单：朝指定方向拖动并松开、快速划动，或单击选择。

entries.english:
Maya hotbox: hold Space; click a menu name, or click a zone for its marking menu.
A quick tap toggles the pane
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 热盒：按住空格键；单击菜单名打开菜单，或单击分区打开标记菜单。轻按空格键切换视图面板。

entries.english: Switch the pane to a Maya camera view (Maya 2022 hotbox centre zone)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将面板切换到 Maya 摄影机视图，对应 Maya 2022 热盒中央分区。

entries.english: Turn the pane under the hotbox into another editor (Maya 2022 hotbox South zone)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将热盒下方的面板切换为其他编辑器，对应 Maya 2022 热盒的南侧分区。

entries.english: Single Perspective layout: leave four views
entries.suggested_chinese: 单透视图布局：退出四视图。

entries.english: Switch to a workspace (Maya panel layouts with Hypershade or Graph Editor)
entries.suggested_chinese: 切换工作区，对应带 Hypershade 或曲线图编辑器的 Maya 面板布局。

entries.english: Show or hide a Maya UI element (Maya 2022 hotbox East zone)
entries.suggested_chinese: 显示或隐藏 Maya 界面元素，对应 Maya 2022 热盒东分区。

entries.english: Only this kind of object can be selected (Maya selection mask preset)
entries.suggested_chinese: 仅允许选择此类对象，对应 Maya 选择遮罩预设。

entries.english: Hotbox style: zones and menu rows, zones only, or centre only (Maya 2022 hotbox centre zone)
entries.suggested_chinese: 热盒样式：分区与菜单行、仅分区，或仅中央分区，对应 Maya 2022 热盒中央分区设置。

entries.english: Run this Maya menu item on the object the marking menu was opened on, like Maya
entries.suggested_chinese: 对打开标记菜单时鼠标所在的对象执行此 Maya 菜单项，与 Maya 行为一致。

entries.english: Select the object and everything under it (Maya: select -hierarchy)
entries.suggested_chinese: 选择对象及其全部下级对象，对应 Maya select -hierarchy。

entries.english: Toggle bounding-box display of the object (Maya: Actions > Bounding Box)
entries.suggested_chinese: 切换对象的边界框显示，对应 Maya“操作 > 边界框”。

entries.english: Make this UV set the current one (Maya: polyUVSet -currentUVSet)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将此 UV 集设为当前集，对应 Maya polyUVSet -currentUVSet。

entries.english: Make this color set the current one (Maya: polyColorSet -currentColorSet)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将此颜色集设为当前颜色集，对应 Maya polyColorSet -currentColorSet。

entries.english: Maya polygon command from a marking menu (convert the selection, then act)
entries.suggested_chinese: 从标记菜单运行 Maya 多边形命令，先转换选择，再执行操作。

entries.english:
Camera-Based Selection: marquee and lasso select only the components you can see (Maya ``cmds.selectPref(useDepth=...)``;
the kit preference "Marquee Selects Hidden Components" the other way)
entries.suggested_chinese: 基于摄影机的选择：框选和套索仅选择可见组件，对应 Maya 的 cmds.selectPref(useDepth=...)；与插件“框选隐藏组件”首选项的含义相反。

entries.english:
Show this node in the Channel Box and the Attribute Editor (Maya: select the node); option box = the
Attribute Editor
entries.suggested_chinese: 在通道盒和属性编辑器中显示此节点，对应 Maya 选择节点；选项框打开属性编辑器。

entries.english: Select, enable or disable every input / output node of the object (Maya Select / Enable / Disable All)
entries.suggested_chinese: 选择、启用或禁用对象的所有输入/输出节点，对应 Maya“全部选择 / 全部启用 / 全部禁用”。

entries.english: The object's input / output nodes with their state (Maya All Inputs... / All Outputs...)
entries.suggested_chinese: 显示对象的输入或输出节点及其状态，对应 Maya“所有输入… / 所有输出…”。

entries.english:
Create an animation layer, empty or with the selected objects (Maya Create Empty Layer / Create Layer from
Selected)
entries.suggested_chinese: 创建空动画层或包含选定对象的动画层，对应 Maya“创建空层 / 根据选定对象创建层”。

entries.english: Add the selected objects to the selected layer, or remove them (Maya Add / Remove Selected Objects)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将选定对象添加到选定层，或从中移除。

entries.english:
Add the Channel Box's selected channels to the selected animation layer, or remove them (Maya Channel Box >
Channels > Add to / Remove From Selected Layers)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将通道盒中选定的通道添加到选定动画层，或从中移除。

entries.english: Delete the selected animation layer and its keys (Maya Delete Layer)
entries.suggested_chinese: 删除选定动画层及其关键帧，对应 Maya“删除层”。

entries.english: Set an identity key on the selected layer's attributes at the current time (Maya Zero Key Layer)
entries.suggested_chinese: 在当前时间为选定层的属性设置恒等关键帧，对应 Maya“为层设置零关键帧”。

entries.english:
Merge the selected layer into BaseAnimation, baking every frame (Maya Merge Layers with BaseAnimation and
the layer selected)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将选定层合并到 BaseAnimation，并逐帧烘焙，对应同时选择 BaseAnimation 和该层后执行 Maya“合并层”。

entries.english:
Make this the selected layer: keys go to it (Maya click on a layer; Ctrl+click adds / removes, Shift+click
selects a range)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将此层设为选定动画层，使新关键帧写入该层。Ctrl+单击添加或移除层选择，Shift+单击选择连续范围。

entries.english: Selected in the Layer Editor (Ctrl / Shift click, step 204)
entries.suggested_chinese: 层编辑器中的选择状态，支持 Ctrl / Shift + 单击。

entries.english: Shift: select the range up to this layer
entries.suggested_chinese: Shift：选择到此层为止的连续范围。

entries.english:
Move the selected objects' animation out of the selected layers into new layers (Maya Extract Selected
Objects; from BaseAnimation: Extract Non-Layered Animation)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将选定对象在所选层上的动画提取到新层，对应“提取选定对象”；从 BaseAnimation 提取时，对应“提取未分层动画”。

entries.english: Copy the selected layers with their members and keys, right above them (Maya Duplicate Layer)
entries.suggested_chinese: 复制选定层及其成员、关键帧，并将副本放在原层正上方，对应 Maya“复制层”。

entries.english: Remove every attribute (member) and its keys from the selected layers (Maya Layers > Empty)
entries.suggested_chinese: 从选定动画层中移除所有属性成员及其关键帧，对应 Maya“层 > 清空”。

entries.english: Delete every animation layer without members (Maya Delete Empty Layers)
entries.suggested_chinese: 删除没有成员的全部动画层，对应 Maya“删除空层”。

entries.english:
Set the selected layers' weight and key it at the current time (Maya Zero Weight and Key Layer / Set Weight
to 1.0 and Key Layer; the Weight row's K button keys the current weight)
entries.suggested_chinese: 设置选定层的权重，并在当前时间为权重设置关键帧，对应“权重归零并为层设置关键帧”或“权重设为 1.0 并为层设置关键帧”。权重行的 K 按钮为当前权重设置关键帧。
提取未分层的 BaseAnimation 动画。

entries.english: Every animated object, not the selection
entries.suggested_chinese: 作用于全部带动画的对象，而不是仅作用于当前选择。

entries.english: Copy members and settings, not the keys
entries.suggested_chinese: 复制成员与设置，不复制关键帧。

entries.english: Key the current weight (Maya's K button)
entries.suggested_chinese: 为当前权重设置关键帧，对应 Maya 的 K 按钮。

entries.english:
Copy the selected geometry at sampled frames into a snapshot group (Maya Visualize > Create Animation
Snapshot)
entries.suggested_chinese: 在采样帧复制选定几何体并放入快照组，对应 Maya“可视化 > 创建动画快照”。

entries.english: Sample the snapshots' sources again (Maya Visualize > Update Snapshot)
entries.suggested_chinese: 重新采样各快照的源对象，对应 Maya“可视化 > 更新快照”。

entries.english:
Maya Bake Simulation: key every transform channel of the selection on each sampled frame; constraints stop
driving the baked channels (muted, kept)
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 烘焙模拟：在各采样帧为所选对象的每个变换通道设置关键帧。约束停止驱动已烘焙通道，但保留约束并将其禁用。

entries.english:
Add an in-between target to the selected target at a weight: the target blends piecewise linearly through it
(Maya Shape Editor Create > Add In-Between Target)
entries.suggested_chinese: 在指定权重处向选定目标添加中间目标，使目标按分段线性方式经过该形状；对应 Maya“形状编辑器 > 创建 > 添加中间目标”。
删除此中间目标，对应 Maya blendShapeDeleteInBetweenTarget。

entries.english:
Add a combination target driven by the selected targets: its weight = their product (or lowest / smooth)
(Maya Shape Editor Create > Add Combination Target)
entries.suggested_chinese: 添加由选定目标驱动的组合目标，其权重为各目标权重的乘积，也可采用最小值或平滑方式；对应 Maya“形状编辑器 > 创建 > 添加组合目标”。

entries.english: How the driver targets combine into this target's weight (Maya combinationShape Combination Method)
entries.suggested_chinese: 设置各驱动目标如何组合为此目标的权重，对应 Maya combinationShape 的“组合方法”。

entries.english: Target weight at which the in-between shape is reached (the target is at 1)
entries.suggested_chinese: 达到中间形状时的目标权重；完整目标位于权重 1。

entries.english: Use the selected meshes as in-between shapes
entries.suggested_chinese: 将选定网格用作中间形状。

entries.english: Driver targets, tab separated (else the picked ones)
entries.suggested_chinese: 驱动目标列表，以制表符分隔；留空则使用选取的目标。

entries.english: A new target (copy of the base)
entries.suggested_chinese: 新目标（基础形状的副本）

entries.english: The selected meshes; the last one is the combination
entries.suggested_chinese: 选定网格；最后选定网格作为组合目标。

entries.draft_origin: 按设置动作拟译；需连同界面位置审阅

entries.english: The last picked target becomes the combination of the others
entries.suggested_chinese: 将最后选取的目标设为其余目标的组合目标。
在形状编辑器中选择的 <blendShape>/<target>\t<target>…

entries.english: Create a Time Slider bookmark (a timeline marker) at the selected range or the current time
entries.suggested_chinese: 在选定时间范围或当前时间创建时间滑块书签，即时间轴标记。

entries.english: Set the playback range to a Time Slider bookmark's range (this one, the next or the previous)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将播放范围设为此时间滑块书签或上一个、下一个书签的范围。

entries.english: Select every node of this type in the scene (Maya Select > All by Type)
entries.suggested_chinese: 选择场景中此类型的全部节点，对应 Maya“选择 > 按类型选择全部”。

entries.english: Make a character set of the selected objects' keyable channels (not Scale / Visibility) and make it current
entries.suggested_chinese: 使用选定对象可设置关键帧的通道创建角色集，并设为当前角色集；不包括缩放与可见性。

entries.english: Add the Channel Box's selected channels to (or remove them from) the current character set
entries.suggested_chinese: 将通道盒中选定的通道添加到当前角色集，或从中移除。

entries.english: Merge the picked character sets into one (Key > Select Character Set Node first; Ctrl adds)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将选取的角色集合并为一个。先用“关键帧 > 选择角色集节点”选取角色集；Ctrl 可添加选择。

entries.english: Set the current character set (Set Key keys its attributes)
entries.suggested_chinese: 设置当前角色集；设置关键帧时为其属性设置关键帧。

entries.english: Select a character set's member objects, or the character set node itself
entries.suggested_chinese: 选择角色集的成员对象，或选择角色集节点本身。

entries.english: The current (or picked) character set's attributes, like Maya's Attribute Editor of the character node
entries.suggested_chinese: 显示当前或选定角色集的属性，对应 Maya 角色节点的属性编辑器。

entries.english: Remove this attribute from the character set
entries.suggested_chinese: 从角色集中移除此属性。

entries.english: List the character sets and edit the current one's members (Maya Relationship Editor: Character Sets)
entries.suggested_chinese: 列出角色集并编辑当前集的成员，对应 Maya“关系编辑器：角色集”。

entries.english: Colour the selected vertices / faces (or meshes) in the current colour set (Maya Mesh Display > Apply Color)
entries.suggested_chinese: 为当前颜色集中的选定顶点、面或网格着色，对应 Maya“网格显示 > 应用颜色”。

entries.english: Rename the current colour set (Maya Mesh Display > Rename Current Set...)
entries.suggested_chinese: 重命名当前颜色集，对应 Maya“网格显示 > 重命名当前集…”。

entries.english:
Change the colours of the current colour set: hue, saturation, value and channel curves (Maya Mesh Display >
Modify Current Set, polyColorMod)
entries.suggested_chinese: 修改当前颜色集的颜色，包括色相、饱和度、明度和通道曲线，对应 Maya“网格显示 > 修改当前集”（polyColorMod）。

entries.english:
Set keys on the colours of the selected vertices / faces (or meshes) in the current colour set (Maya Mesh
Display > Set Keyframe for Vertex Color)
entries.suggested_chinese: 为当前颜色集中所选顶点、面或网格的颜色设置关键帧，对应 Maya“网格显示 > 为顶点颜色设置关键帧”。

entries.english:
Make a new vertex bake set with Maya's factory prelight settings and assign the selected meshes to it (Maya
Mesh Display > Assign New Set)
entries.suggested_chinese: 采用 Maya 默认预照明设置创建顶点烘焙集，并将选定网格指定到该集，对应 Maya“网格显示 > 指定新集”。

entries.english: Assign the selected meshes to an existing vertex bake set (Maya Mesh Display > Assign Existing Set)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将选定网格指定给现有顶点烘焙集，对应 Maya“网格显示 > 指定现有集”。

entries.english:
Edit the vertex bake set of the selected mesh: what Prelight bakes and how it mixes (Maya Mesh Display > Edit
Assigned Set)
entries.suggested_chinese: 编辑选定网格的顶点烘焙集，设置预照明的烘焙内容及混合方式，对应 Maya“网格显示 > 编辑指定集”。

entries.english:
Bake the scene lighting of the selected meshes into their current colour set (Maya Mesh Display > Prelight;
Blender: a Cycles diffuse bake)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将场景照明烘焙到选定网格当前颜色集，对应 Maya“网格显示 > 预照明”；在 Blender 中通过 Cycles 漫反射烘焙实现。

entries.english:
Select the other instances of the selected mesh (objects sharing its mesh data) (Maya Mesh Display > Per
Instance Sharing > Select Shared Instances)
entries.suggested_chinese: 选择选定网格的其他实例，即共享网格数据的对象；对应 Maya“网格显示 > 按实例共享 > 选择共享实例”。

entries.english: Clear the selection and go back to object mode (Maya Alt+D)
entries.suggested_chinese: 清除选择并返回对象模式，对应 Maya Alt+D。

entries.english:
Bevel the selection now (Maya Ctrl+B, polyBevel3): change Fraction, Segments, Depth in the In-View Editor or
Channel Box INPUTS; in vertex mode Chamfer Vertex
entries.suggested_chinese: 立即为选择倒角，对应 Maya Ctrl+B 和 polyBevel3。在视口编辑器或通道盒“输入”中调整比例、分段数和深度；顶点模式下执行顶点切角。

entries.english:
Change the last bevel (Maya: edit the polyBevel node). Blender keeps no edit-mode history, so only the last
one can be changed
entries.suggested_chinese: 修改最近一次倒角，对应 Maya 编辑 polyBevel 节点。Blender 不保留编辑模式历史，因此只能修改最近一次倒角。

entries.english: Convert the selection to the vertices, edges or faces it touches (Maya Ctrl+F9-F11)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将所选内容转换为与之相接的顶点、边或面，对应 Maya Ctrl+F9–F11。

entries.english:
Delete the selected faces, edges (non-border, cleaning up their vertices) or vertices
right away, by the select mode (Maya Delete on components)
entries.suggested_chinese: 根据当前组件选择模式，立即删除选定面、非边界边及其多余顶点，或选定顶点，对应 Maya 的组件 Delete 操作。

entries.english:
Select the edge loops (or rings) of the selected edges (Maya Select > Contiguous Edges, Convert
Selection > To Edge Loop / Ring)
entries.suggested_chinese: 根据所选边选择对应循环边或环形边，对应 Maya“选择 > 连续边”及“转换选择 > 到循环边 / 环形边”。

entries.english: Bevel width as a fraction of the shortest edge it slides along
entries.suggested_chinese: 倒角宽度，以沿其滑移的最短边长度的比例表示。

entries.english: Use Fraction (off: Offset in Maya units)
entries.suggested_chinese: 使用比例；关闭后使用 Maya 单位的偏移距离。

entries.english: Bevel width in Maya units when Offset As Fraction is off
entries.suggested_chinese: 关闭“偏移作为比例”时，倒角宽度使用 Maya 单位。

entries.english: Roundness of the bevel: 1 round, 0 flat, -1 inverted
entries.suggested_chinese: 倒角圆度：1 为圆形，0 为平直，-1 为内凹。

entries.english:
Maya Normal constraint: select the target surface(s), then the object; its aim vector follows the surface
normal at the closest point
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 法线约束：先选目标曲面，再选对象；使对象的目标向量跟随曲面最近点处的法线。

entries.english:
Maya Tangent constraint: select the target curve(s), then the object; its aim vector follows the curve
tangent at the closest point
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 切线约束：先选择目标曲线，再选择受约束对象；对象的目标向量沿曲线上最近点的切线方向。

entries.english:
Maya Remove Target: select the target(s), then the constrained object; the constraints from those targets go
(the last one of a type leaves the channels where the constraint had them)
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya“移除目标”：先选择目标，再选择受约束对象，移除这些目标产生的约束；若移除某类型的最后一个约束，则通道保持约束结束时的值。

entries.english:
Maya Set Rest Position: the constrained objects' current values become where they go when the constraint
weights are 0
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya“设置静止位置”：受约束对象的当前值成为约束权重为 0 时采用的值。

entries.english:
Maya Modify Constrained Axis: which axes the selected objects' point / orient / scale / parent constraints
drive
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 修改约束轴：指定所选对象的点约束、方向约束、缩放约束及父约束驱动哪些轴。

entries.english: Preserve the current offset of the constrained objects
entries.suggested_chinese: 保留受约束对象当前的偏移。

entries.english: Maya Interp Type of an orient / parent constraint node (how several targets' rotations are blended)
entries.suggested_chinese: 设置 Maya 方向约束或父约束节点的插值类型，即多个目标旋转之间的混合方式。

entries.english: Turn the Maya constraint node on / off (every Blender constraint of the multi-target group)
entries.suggested_chinese: 启用或禁用 Maya 约束节点，同时影响对应多目标组内的所有 Blender 约束。

entries.english:
Give the active joint (or curve) the selected curves' shapes (Maya parent -s -r): the curve becomes the joint's
control shape
entries.suggested_chinese: 将选定曲线的形状赋给活动关节或曲线，对应 Maya parent -s -r；曲线成为关节的控制形状。

entries.draft_origin: 本地 Blender 整句译文
本地 Maya 术语草稿

entries.english: Tag the selected joints / controls as controllers: pick walk (arrow keys) then follows controllers (Maya)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将选定关节或控制器标记为控制器；之后方向键遍历选择会沿控制器层次进行，对应 Maya 控制器标签。

entries.english: Make the last selected control the parent controller of the other selected controls (Maya controller -p)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将最后选定控制器设为其他选定控制器的父控制器，对应 Maya controller -p。

entries.english: Blender has no ambient light: World colour (flat part) + a point light (Ambient Shade part).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有环境光：使用世界颜色实现均匀部分，点光源实现环境着色部分。

entries.english: Blender has no volume light: a point light cut at the sphere (exact in Cycles, EEVEE approximates the falloff).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有体积光源；此处用在球体边界截断的点光源替代。Cycles 中效果精确，EEVEE 仅近似衰减。

entries.english:
Create a primitive, light, camera or locator at the origin with Maya's default
size and name (Maya Create menu)
entries.suggested_chinese: 按 Maya 默认尺寸和名称，在原点创建基本体、灯光、摄影机或定位器，对应 Maya“创建”菜单。

entries.english:
Smoke or fire from the selected meshes in a Mantaflow domain sized in Maya units
(Maya Fluids > 3D Container, Effects > Fire / Smoke)
entries.suggested_chinese: 在按 Maya 单位设置的 Mantaflow 域中，从选定网格发射烟雾或火焰，对应 Maya“流体 > 三维容器”及“效果 > 火 / 烟”。

entries.english: Create a {KINDS[props.kind][0]} at the origin, Maya default size and name
entries.suggested_chinese: 在原点创建 {KINDS[props.kind][0]}，采用 Maya 默认尺寸和命名。

entries.english: Maya CV Curve Tool: click to place CVs (drag to move the new one), Enter to finish, Backspace removes the last
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 控制顶点曲线工具：单击放置控制顶点，拖动移动新点，Enter 完成，Backspace 删除最后一点。

entries.english: Maya EP Curve Tool: click edit points the curve passes through, Enter to finish, Backspace removes the last
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 编辑点曲线工具：单击曲线要经过的编辑点，按 Enter 完成，Backspace 移除上一点。

entries.english: Maya Three Point Circular Arc: click the start, a point on the arc and the end
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 三点圆弧：依次单击起点、弧上的一点和终点。

entries.english: Maya Two Point Circular Arc: click the start and the end
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 两点圆弧：单击起点和终点。

entries.english: JSON list of world points: make the curve without clicks (scripts)
entries.suggested_chinese: 世界空间点的 JSON 列表，用于脚本无需单击即可创建曲线。

entries.english: Fill the selected closed curves with a flat surface (Maya Surfaces > Planar)
entries.suggested_chinese: 使用平面曲面填充选定闭合曲线，对应 Maya“曲面 > 平面”。

entries.english: Make a bevelled solid from the selected closed curves, the curves kept (Maya Surfaces > Bevel Plus)
entries.suggested_chinese: 根据选定闭合曲线生成带倒角的实体，并保留原曲线，对应 Maya“曲面 > 增强倒角”。

entries.english: Make a copy of the selected curves moved sideways in their plane (Maya Curves > Offset > Offset Curve)
entries.suggested_chinese: 在选定曲线所在平面内向侧面偏移并生成副本，对应 Maya“曲线 > 偏移 > 偏移曲线”。

entries.english: Make a tube mesh along the selected curves, the curves kept (Maya Create > Sweep Mesh)
entries.suggested_chinese: 沿选定曲线生成管状网格，并保留曲线，对应 Maya“创建 > 扫描网格”。

entries.english: Draw a new curve freehand (Maya Create > Curve Tools > Pencil Curve Tool: Blender's curve Draw tool)
entries.suggested_chinese: 徒手绘制新曲线，对应 Maya“创建 > 曲线工具 > 铅笔曲线工具”，底层使用 Blender 曲线绘制工具。

entries.english: Add points at the end of the selected curve (Maya Curves > Add Points Tool: extrude the end point)
entries.suggested_chinese: 在选定曲线末端添加点，对应 Maya“曲线 > 添加点工具”，通过挤出端点实现。

entries.draft_origin: 本地 Blender 整句译文

entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 单位，用于 offsetCurve 距离。

entries.english: Bend, curl or scale the curvature of the selected curves (Maya Curves > Bend / Curl / Scale Curvature)
entries.suggested_chinese: 弯曲、卷曲或缩放选定曲线的曲率，对应 Maya“曲线 > 弯曲 / 卷曲 / 缩放曲率”。

entries.english:
Lock or unlock the length of the selected curves: CV edits then keep the curve's length (Maya Curves > Lock /
Unlock Length; the shape's lockLength attribute)
entries.suggested_chinese: 锁定或解锁选定曲线的长度；锁定后编辑控制顶点会保持曲线长度，对应 Maya“曲线 > 锁定/解锁长度”及形状的 lockLength 属性。

entries.english:
Give the selected CV full knot multiplicity so the curve passes through it with a corner (Maya Curves > CV
Hardness; Maya hardens the last selected CV, and only CVs away from the curve ends)
entries.suggested_chinese: 为选定控制顶点赋予完整节点重数，使曲线经过该点并形成角点，对应 Maya“曲线 > 控制顶点硬度”。Maya 仅硬化最后选定且远离曲线两端的控制顶点。

entries.english: A cubic curve through the CVs of each selected linear curve (Maya Curves > Fit B-spline)
entries.suggested_chinese: 通过各选定线性曲线的控制顶点拟合三次曲线，对应 Maya“曲线 > 拟合 B 样条线”。

entries.english:
Move the first selected curve onto the nearest end of the second with matching tangent (Maya Curves > Align;
factory position + tangent)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将首个选定曲线移到第二条曲线最近的端点，并匹配切线，对应 Maya“曲线 > 对齐”，默认匹配位置和切线。

entries.english:
Curves from the surface's isoparms: every visible isoparm of a selected surface, or the isoparms through the
selected CV rows / columns in edit mode (Maya Curves > Duplicate Surface Curves)
entries.suggested_chinese: 从曲面等参线复制曲线：对象模式复制选定曲面所有可见等参线；编辑模式复制穿过选定控制顶点行或列的等参线。

entries.english: Mark where the selected curves cross with a locator on each curve (Maya Curves > Intersect)
entries.suggested_chinese: 在选定曲线的交点处，为每条曲线分别创建定位器，对应 Maya“曲线 > 相交”。

entries.draft_origin: 本地 Blender 整句译文

entries.english: Rebuild the selected curves with uniform spans (Maya Curves > Rebuild; factory 4 spans, degree 3)
entries.suggested_chinese: 以均匀跨度重建选定曲线，对应 Maya“曲线 > 重建”；默认 4 个跨度、3 次。

entries.english: Join two curves into a new one at their nearest ends (Maya Curves > Attach; factory Blend, bias 0.5)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将两条曲线最近的端点附加为一条新曲线，对应 Maya“曲线 > 附加”；默认使用混合方式，偏置为 0.5。

entries.english: Split the curve at the edit point nearest each selected CV (Maya Curves > Detach)
entries.suggested_chinese: 在最接近各选定控制顶点的编辑点处分离曲线，对应 Maya“曲线 > 分离”。

entries.english: Cut the selected curves where they cross, keeping all pieces (Maya Curves > Cut)
entries.suggested_chinese: 在选定曲线交点处剪切，并保留全部片段，对应 Maya“曲线 > 剪切”。

entries.english: A circular fillet curve between two curves (Maya Curves > Fillet; factory radius 1)
entries.suggested_chinese: 在两条曲线之间创建圆角曲线，对应 Maya“曲线 > 圆角”；默认半径为 1。

entries.english: Lay every CV leg of the selected curves on one line, keeping their lengths (Maya Curves > Straighten)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将选定曲线的每段控制多边形拉到同一直线上，同时保持各段长度，对应 Maya“曲线 > 拉直”。

entries.english:

entries.suggested_chinese: FBX 仅导出参与蒙皮变形的关节，例如 Rigify 的 DEF 骨骼，并按变形链建立父子关系；辅助骨骼和控制骨骼不导出。

entries.english: FBX: '-', '.' and other characters Maya can't have in a node name become '_' (DEF-spine.001 -> DEF_spine_001)
entries.suggested_chinese: FBX：将 Maya 节点名不支持的“-”“.”等字符替换为“_”，例如 DEF-spine.001 → DEF_spine_001。

entries.english:
Make a lattice around each selected object that bends along its motion path (Maya Constrain > Motion Paths >
Flow Path Object)
entries.suggested_chinese: 在各选定对象周围创建晶格，使其沿运动路径弯曲，对应 Maya“约束 > 运动路径 > 流动路径对象”。

entries.english:
Bake translate/rotate/scale into the geometry: the channels read 0/0/1 and the
pivot stays in place (Maya Modify > Freeze Transformations)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将平移、旋转和缩放烘焙到几何体，使通道值恢复为 0/0/1，并保持枢轴位置，对应 Maya“修改 > 冻结变换”。

entries.english:
Set translate/rotate/scale back to 0/0/1, i.e. to the last frozen state
(Maya Modify > Reset Transformations)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将平移、旋转和缩放恢复为 0/0/1，即最近一次冻结后的状态，对应 Maya“修改 > 重置变换”。

entries.english:
Move the pivot (origin) to the centre of the bounding box without moving the
geometry or changing translate (Maya Modify > Center Pivot)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将枢轴（原点）移到边界框中心，不移动几何体，也不改变平移通道值，对应 Maya“修改 > 居中枢轴”。

entries.english:
Create a point emitter at the origin: a one-vertex mesh emitter1 with the particles nParticle1
(Maya nParticles > Create Emitter; Blender particles come from a mesh)
entries.suggested_chinese: 在原点创建点发射器：用单顶点网格 emitter1 发射 nParticle1 粒子，对应 Maya“nParticles > 创建发射器”。Blender 粒子从网格发射。

entries.english: Emit particles from the selected meshes' vertices (Maya nParticles > Emit from Object)
entries.suggested_chinese: 从选定网格的顶点发射粒子，对应 Maya“nParticles > 从对象发射”。

entries.english:
Make the selected meshes nCloth: Blender cloth scaled to Maya units and the nucleus
(Maya nCloth > Create nCloth)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将选定网格设为 nCloth，使用按 Maya 单位和 nucleus 缩放的 Blender 布料模拟，对应 Maya“nCloth > 创建 nCloth”。

entries.english: Remove the cloth from the selected meshes (Maya nCloth > Remove nCloth)
entries.suggested_chinese: 从选定网格移除布料，对应 Maya“nCloth > 移除 nCloth”。

entries.english: Make the selected meshes collide with cloth and particles (Maya nCloth > Create Passive Collider)
entries.suggested_chinese: 使选定网格与布料和粒子碰撞，对应 Maya“nCloth > 创建被动碰撞体”。

entries.english: Make the selected meshes rigid bodies in Maya units (Maya Fields/Solvers > Create Active / Passive Rigid Body)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将选定网格创建为 Maya 单位下的刚体，对应“场/解算器 > 创建主动 / 被动刚体”。

entries.english:
Bake or delete the simulation caches of the selection, or of the whole scene when nothing is selected
(Maya nCache; Blender keeps a cache per object, saved with the file)
entries.suggested_chinese: 烘焙或删除选定对象的模拟缓存；没有选择时处理整个场景。对应 Maya nCache；Blender 为每个对象保存独立缓存，并随文件保存。

entries.english:
Create a 3D fluid container with an emitter at the origin (Maya FX shelf: 3D Fluid Container with
Emitter; a Mantaflow smoke domain around an emitter mesh)
entries.suggested_chinese: 在原点创建带发射器的三维流体容器，对应 Maya 特效工具架；使用包围发射器网格的 Mantaflow 烟雾域实现。

entries.english: Make the selected meshes collide with fluids (Maya Fluids > Make Collide: a Mantaflow effector)
entries.suggested_chinese: 使选定网格与流体碰撞，对应 Maya“流体 > 创建碰撞”，通过 Mantaflow 效果器实现。

entries.english:
Show the selected cloth objects' input mesh (cloth off in the viewport) or the simulated current mesh
(Maya nCloth > Display Input Mesh / Display Current Mesh)
entries.suggested_chinese: 显示所选布料对象的输入网格（在视口中关闭布料模拟），或显示模拟后的当前网格，对应 Maya“nCloth > 显示输入网格 / 显示当前网格”。

entries.english: Cut the selected objects (Maya Ctrl+X): copy them to the clipboard, then delete them. Ctrl+V pastes them back
entries.suggested_chinese: 剪切选定对象，对应 Maya Ctrl+X：先复制到剪贴板，再删除；Ctrl+V 可粘贴回来。

entries.english: Paste the clipboard objects (Maya Ctrl+V): pasted__ names, under a new group that stays selected
entries.suggested_chinese: 粘贴剪贴板对象，对应 Maya Ctrl + V；使用 pasted__ 名称，放入新组并保持新组选定。

entries.english: Set the playback range to the animation range (Maya Alt+\)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将播放范围设为整个动画范围，对应 Maya Alt+\。

entries.english: Show or hide one object type in the view under the mouse (Maya Alt+1 / Alt+2 / Alt+4)
entries.suggested_chinese: 显示或隐藏鼠标所在视图中的某类对象，对应 Maya Alt+1 / Alt+2 / Alt+4。

entries.english: Maya smooth proxy keys: Ctrl+` toggle cage / smooth, Shift+~ show both, Ctrl+Shift+~ create
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 平滑代理快捷键：Ctrl + ` 切换控制笼与平滑结果，Shift + ~ 同时显示两者，Ctrl + Shift + ~ 创建代理。

entries.english: Store a copy of the selected curves to swap back to later (Maya Curves > Buffer Curve Snapshot)
entries.suggested_chinese: 保存选定曲线的副本，以便之后交换恢复，对应 Maya“曲线 > 缓冲曲线快照”。

entries.english: Exchange the selected curves with their buffer curves (Maya Curves > Swap Buffer Curve)
entries.suggested_chinese: 交换选定曲线与其缓冲曲线，对应 Maya“曲线 > 交换缓冲曲线”。

entries.english:
Change how rotation interpolates between keys on the selected rotate curves' nodes (Maya Curves > Change
Rotation Interp)
entries.suggested_chinese: 修改选定旋转曲线所属节点在关键帧之间的旋转插值方式，对应 Maya“曲线 > 更改旋转插值”。

entries.english:
Give every curve shown a key wherever another has one within the selected keys' time range (Maya Curves >
Key Sync Filter)
entries.suggested_chinese: 在选定关键帧的时间范围内，只要任一显示曲线在某时间有关键帧，就为其余显示曲线补上关键帧，对应 Maya“曲线 > 关键帧同步过滤器”。

entries.english:
Replace isolated spikes among the selected keys by their neighbours' mean (Maya Curves > Peak Removal
Filter)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将选定关键帧中的孤立尖峰替换为相邻关键帧的平均值，对应 Maya“曲线 > 去除峰值过滤器”。

entries.english:
Select the curves of the selected keys (Maya Edit > Select Curve Nodes; Blender's curves aren't scene nodes:
their channels are selected)
entries.suggested_chinese: 选择选定关键帧所在的曲线，对应 Maya“编辑 > 选择曲线节点”。Blender 曲线不是场景节点，因此改为选择对应通道。

entries.draft_origin: 已逐句校订的本地草稿

entries.english:
Mute the selected keys: the curve holds the key's value until the next unmuted key (Maya Keys > Mute Key;
Blender has no per-key mute: a Stepped modifier named "Maya mute" holds the value)
entries.suggested_chinese: 禁用选定关键帧：保持该帧的值，直到下一个未禁用的关键帧。Blender 无逐帧禁用功能，因此用名为“Maya mute”的阶跃修改器保持该值。

entries.english:
Add or remove an inbetween: the keys after the current time on the curves shown move one frame later or
earlier (Maya Keys > Add / Remove Inbetween)
entries.suggested_chinese: 添加或移除中间帧：将当前显示曲线中位于当前时间之后的关键帧后移或前移一帧。

entries.english: Choose what a click or drag picks in the Graph Editor (Maya Select > All / Only Curve)
entries.suggested_chinese: 选择单击或拖动在曲线图编辑器中可选取的内容，对应 Maya“选择 > 全部 / 仅曲线”。

entries.english: Run this Graph Editor curve command on the curves of the selected keys (Maya Dope Sheet > Curves)
entries.suggested_chinese: 对选定关键帧所属曲线执行此曲线图编辑器命令，对应 Maya“摄影表 > 曲线”。

entries.english: Unmute the selected keys: the curve plays through them again (Maya Keys > Unmute Key)
entries.suggested_chinese: 取消禁用选定关键帧，使曲线重新经过这些关键帧，对应 Maya“关键帧 > 取消禁用关键帧”。

entries.draft_origin: 本地 Maya 术语草稿

entries.english:
Set the in and out tangents: the selected keys in the Graph Editor, else the selection's keys at the
current time (Maya Graph Editor tangent buttons, Shift+S marking menu)
entries.suggested_chinese: 设置入切线和出切线：优先作用于曲线图编辑器中选定的关键帧，否则作用于所选对象当前时间处的关键帧。对应切线按钮及 Shift + S 标记菜单。

entries.english:
Edit keys: the selected keys in the Graph Editor, else the selection's keys at the current time
(Maya Shift+S marking menu > Keys)
entries.suggested_chinese: 编辑关键帧：优先作用于曲线图编辑器中的选定关键帧，否则作用于所选对象当前时间处的关键帧，对应 Shift + S 标记菜单的“关键帧”。

entries.english: Absolute / Stacked / Normalized curve view (Maya Graph Editor 1 / 2 / 3)
entries.suggested_chinese: 切换曲线的绝对、堆叠或规格化视图，对应 Maya 曲线图编辑器的 1 / 2 / 3。

entries.english: Center the Graph Editor on the current time, keeping the zoom (Maya t)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将曲线图编辑器居中到当前时间，保持缩放比例，对应 Maya t。

entries.english:
Maya 2026 Dope Sheet keys: g frames the playback range, t centres the current time, h / j lock / unlock the
selected channels (the same as the Graph Editor's keys in Maya 2026)
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 2026 摄影表快捷键：g 框显播放范围，t 将当前时间居中，h / j 锁定或解锁选定通道，与 Maya 2026 曲线图编辑器相同。

entries.english: Turn Snap Time To Selection on or off: selecting keys moves the current time to them (Maya Alt+/)
entries.suggested_chinese: 切换“将时间吸附到选择”：选择关键帧时，将当前时间移到这些关键帧，对应 Maya Alt+/。

entries.english:
Insert Key tool while held: MMB click / drag in the Graph Editor inserts a key on the selected curves at that
frame, keeping the curve shape (Maya i)
entries.suggested_chinese: 按住时启用插入关键帧工具：在曲线图编辑器中单击或拖动鼠标中键，在对应帧为选定曲线插入关键帧并保持曲线形状，对应 Maya 的 i。

entries.english:
Maya Curves > Pre / Post Infinity on the selected curves: Cycle / Cycle with Offset / Oscillate = a Cycles
modifier side, Linear / Constant = the curve's extrapolation (Blender's is the same on both sides)
entries.suggested_chinese: 为选定曲线设置 Maya 前无穷或后无穷：循环、带偏移循环和振荡通过循环修改器对应侧实现；线性和常量通过曲线外推实现。Blender 两侧共用同一种外推方式。

entries.english: Maya Edit > Change Curve Color (option box = the colour) / Remove Curve Color on the selected curves
entries.suggested_chinese: 对选定曲线执行 Maya“编辑 > 更改曲线颜色”或“移除曲线颜色”；选项框用于选择颜色。

entries.english: Select the keys that aren't on whole frames (Maya Edit > Select Unsnapped)
entries.suggested_chinese: 选择不在整帧上的关键帧，对应 Maya“编辑 > 选择未吸附关键帧”。

entries.english: Add the attributes of the selected channels to the curve colour rules (magenta)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将选定通道对应的属性添加到曲线颜色规则，使用洋红色。

entries.english: Edit the curve colouring rules: every curve of an attribute gets its colour (Maya Set Curve Colors)
entries.suggested_chinese: 编辑曲线颜色规则，使同一属性的曲线采用指定颜色，对应 Maya“设置曲线颜色”。

entries.english:
Add Key tool: middle-click in the Graph Editor adds a key at that frame and value on the selected curves

entries.suggested_chinese: 添加关键帧工具：在曲线图编辑器中单击鼠标中键，在对应时间和值处为选定曲线添加关键帧；按 Esc 结束。

entries.english:
Maya Retime Tool: double-click in the curve area to add retime markers, drag a marker's handle to scale and
ripple the keys of the displayed curves, the ✕ deletes a marker. Esc or Q/W/E/R/T ends the tool
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 重定时工具：双击曲线区域添加重定时标记，拖动标记控制柄可缩放并连带移动显示曲线的关键帧；点击 ✕ 删除标记。按 Esc 或 Q/W/E/R/T 结束。

entries.english:
Weighted tangents keep their length; non-weighted ones stay a third of the way to the next key
(Maya Curves > Weighted / Non-weighted Tangents)
entries.suggested_chinese: 加权切线保留控制柄长度；非加权切线的控制柄保持在距相邻关键帧三分之一的位置，对应 Maya“曲线 > 加权/非加权切线”。

entries.english: Lock or free the length of the selected keys' tangents (Maya Tangents > Lock / Free Tangent Length)
entries.suggested_chinese: 锁定或释放选定关键帧切线的长度，对应 Maya“切线 > 锁定 / 自由切线长度”。

entries.english: Make the curves' tangents non-weighted: every tangent a third of the way to the next key, its angle kept (Maya Curves > Non-weighted Tangents)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将曲线切线设为非加权：各切线控制柄位于距下一关键帧三分之一的位置，保持原有角度。

entries.english: Make the curves' tangents weighted: their length can change (Maya Curves > Weighted Tangents)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将曲线切线设为加权，允许修改控制柄长度，对应 Maya“曲线 > 加权切线”。

entries.english: Dragging a tangent changes its length (Maya Tangents > Free Tangent Length)
entries.suggested_chinese: 拖动切线时允许改变控制柄长度，对应 Maya“切线 > 自由切线长度”。

entries.english: Changing a tangent's angle keeps its length (Maya Tangents > Lock Tangent Length)
entries.suggested_chinese: 更改切线角度时保持长度不变，对应 Maya“切线 > 锁定切线长度”。

entries.english: Move the children of the selected groups up one level and delete the groups (Maya Ungroup)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将选定组的子对象上移一个层级，并删除组，对应 Maya“取消编组”。

entries.english: Group the selected objects under a new transform (Maya Ctrl+G)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将选定对象编组到新变换节点下，对应 Maya Ctrl + G。

entries.english: Under the group's parent (Maya Ungroup Options, factory)
entries.suggested_chinese: 置于该组的父对象下，对应 Maya 取消编组选项的默认值。

entries.english: At the top of the hierarchy
Keep the children where they are (off = the group's transform goes into their local values)
entries.suggested_chinese: 保持子对象位置不变；关闭后，将组变换计入子对象的局部变换值。

entries.english:
Bake the modifier stack and shape keys into the mesh (Maya Edit > Delete by
Type > History, Alt+Shift+D)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将修改器堆栈和形态键烘焙到网格，对应 Maya“编辑 > 按类型删除 > 历史”（Alt + Shift + D）。

entries.english:
Delete one kind of node from the selection or the whole scene

entries.english:
Cut the shape of the active (second) face as a hole into the other selected face of the same mesh
(Maya Mesh Tools > Make Hole)

entries.english:
Merge the selected vertices closer than the threshold to their centre; two vertices always merge
(Maya Edit Mesh > Merge)

(Maya Mesh > Smooth)

mirrored positions (Maya Edit Mesh > Symmetrize). Esc / right click cancels
entries.suggested_chinese: 单击对称接缝上的网格边，将所选组件在另一侧的对应组件移至镜像位置，对应 Maya“编辑网格 > 对称化”。按 Esc 或单击右键取消。

entries.english:
Resolution of Render Current Frame / Render Sequence (Maya Render > Test Resolution; batch renders use the
Render Settings size)
entries.suggested_chinese: “渲染当前帧”和“渲染序列”的分辨率，对应 Maya“渲染 > 测试分辨率”；批渲染使用“渲染设置”的尺寸。

entries.english:
Render the scene in a separate Blender process (Maya Render > Batch Render): the frame range when the
output name has a frame number, else the current frame
entries.suggested_chinese: 在独立的 Blender 进程中渲染场景，对应 Maya“渲染 > 批渲染”。输出名称含帧号时渲染帧范围，否则渲染当前帧。

entries.english: Stop the running batch render (Maya Render > Cancel Batch Render)
entries.suggested_chinese: 停止正在运行的批渲染，对应 Maya“渲染 > 取消批渲染”。

entries.english: Show the last image of the batch render in an Image Editor window (Maya Render > Show Batch Render)
entries.suggested_chinese: 在图像编辑器窗口中显示批渲染的最后一张图像，对应 Maya“渲染 > 显示批渲染”。

entries.english: Number of processors to use (0 = all, Maya Batch Render Frame)
entries.suggested_chinese: 使用的处理器数量；0 表示全部，对应 Maya 批渲染帧。

entries.english:
Render the current frame through the active view's camera (Maya Render > Render Current Frame:
persp when the view isn't looking through a camera)
entries.suggested_chinese: 通过活动视图的摄影机渲染当前帧，对应 Maya“渲染 > 渲染当前帧”；若视图未处于摄影机视角，则使用 persp。

entries.english: Render the animation range through the active view's camera (Maya Render > Render Sequence)
entries.suggested_chinese: 通过活动视图的摄影机渲染动画范围，对应 Maya“渲染 > 渲染序列”。

entries.english: Repeat the last command: menu, shelf and marking-menu items too (Maya G)
entries.suggested_chinese: 重复上一条命令，包括菜单、工具架和标记菜单项，对应 Maya G。

entries.english: Run a Recent Commands entry again
entries.suggested_chinese: 再次执行最近使用的命令。

entries.english: Make the selected joint the root of its skeleton (Maya Skeleton > Reroot Skeleton)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将选定关节设为骨架根关节，对应 Maya“骨架 > 重设骨架根”。

entries.english:
Remember the selected joints' current rotation as their preferred angle (Maya Skeleton > Set Preferred
Angle)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将选定关节当前旋转保存为首选角度，对应 Maya“骨架 > 设置首选角度”。

entries.english: Turn the selected joints back to their preferred angle (Maya Skeleton > Assume Preferred Angle)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将选定关节恢复到首选角度，对应 Maya“骨架 > 采用首选角度”。

entries.english:
Create a spline IK from the start joint to the end joint: a new curve through the chain, or (Auto create
curve off) the selected / clicked curve (Maya Skeleton > Create IK Spline Handle)
entries.suggested_chinese: 从起始关节到结束关节创建 IK 样条线。可新建穿过关节链的曲线；关闭“自动创建曲线”时，使用已选定或单击的曲线，对应 Maya“骨架 > 创建 IK 样条线控制柄”。

entries.english:
Add the selected joints to the selected skinned mesh; the weights are recomputed by distance (Maya Skin >
Edit Influences > Add Influence)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将选定关节添加到选定蒙皮网格，并按距离重新计算权重；对应 Maya“蒙皮 > 编辑影响对象 > 添加影响对象”。

entries.english:
Remove the selected joints from the selected skinned mesh; the weights are renormalised (Maya Skin > Edit
Influences > Remove Influence)
entries.suggested_chinese: 从选定蒙皮网格移除选定关节，并重新规格化权重，对应 Maya“蒙皮 > 编辑影响对象 > 移除影响对象”。

entries.english:
Remove influences that weigh nothing on any vertex (Maya Skin > Edit Influences > Remove Unused
Influences)
entries.suggested_chinese: 移除对所有顶点的权重都为零的影响对象，对应 Maya“蒙皮 > 编辑影响对象 > 移除未使用的影响对象”。

entries.english: Give the selected vertices the average skin weights of their neighbours (Maya Skin > Hammer Skin Weights)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将选定顶点的蒙皮权重设为邻接顶点的平均值，对应 Maya“蒙皮 > 锤形蒙皮权重”。

entries.english:
Make a cluster of the selected components (or the whole object): a Hook modifier ``clusterN`` driven by the
handle ``clusterNHandle`` at their centre (Maya Deform > Cluster)
entries.suggested_chinese: 为所选组件或整个对象创建簇：在其中心放置 clusterNHandle 控制柄，驱动名为 clusterN 的钩挂修改器，对应 Maya“变形 > 簇”。

entries.english:
Soft modification at the selection: a Hook modifier ``softModN`` on the whole mesh with Maya's falloff
(radius 5, smooth) driven by ``softModNHandle`` (Maya Deform > Soft Modification)
entries.suggested_chinese: 在选择位置创建软修改：为整个网格添加名为 softModN 的钩挂修改器，由 softModNHandle 驱动，使用 Maya 的平滑衰减和默认半径 5，对应“变形 > 软修改”。

entries.english:
Maya click modifiers in this editor (Ctrl+Shift adds, Ctrl deselects; a Graph Editor click on a selected key
keeps the selection): remembers the selection, lets Blender's click run (the press stays free for a drag), then
writes Maya's result
entries.suggested_chinese: 在此编辑器中使用 Maya 的选择修饰键：Ctrl+Shift 添加，Ctrl 取消选择；在曲线图编辑器中单击已选关键帧时保留当前选择。先记录原选择，让 Blender 处理单击与拖动，再应用 Maya 规则的选择结果。

entries.english:
Maya Shift+marquee = toggle: remembers the selection, Blender's box (mode Set) runs, then the box's items are
toggled against what was selected
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 的 Shift+框选切换选择状态：先记录原选择，再让 Blender 以“替换”模式框选，最后按原选择切换框内项目的选择状态。

entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 选择菜单中的选择转换，包括沿循环扩大或缩小、周界、面路径、壳边界及 UV。

entries.suggested_chinese: 编辑集：添加或移除选定对象、重命名、删除，以及显示集成员。

entries.english: Maya Remove Joint: delete the selected joints; their children move up to the parent and stay where they are
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 移除关节：删除选定关节，其子关节上移到被删除关节的父级，并保持位置。

entries.english: Maya Disconnect Joint: the selected joint becomes the root of its own skeleton, a new end joint stays behind
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 断开关节：将选定关节变为独立骨架的根，并在原链上留下新的末端关节。

entries.english: Maya Connect Joint: select a root joint, then the joint to connect it to
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 连接关节：先选择根关节，再选择要连接到的关节。

entries.english: Maya Insert Joint Tool: click a joint and drag to place a new joint between it and its children
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 插入关节工具：单击关节并拖动，在该关节与其子关节之间放置新关节。

entries.english: Maya IK Handle Tool: click the start joint, then the end joint (or select both joints first)
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya IK 控制柄工具：先单击起始关节，再单击结束关节；也可事先选中这两个关节。

entries.english: Maya Pole Vector constraint: select the pole object, then the IK handle
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 极向量约束：先选择极向量对象，再选择 IK 控制柄。

entries.english: Maya Bind Skin Options question for a mesh that already has a skin
entries.suggested_chinese: 为已有蒙皮的网格显示 Maya 风格的绑定蒙皮确认问题。

entries.english: No: leave the mesh with its one skin
Maya Bind Skin: the selected skeleton and meshes, in any order (closest distance weights, no parenting)
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 绑定蒙皮：选择骨架和网格，顺序不限；使用最近距离权重，不建立父子关系。

entries.english: Maya Unbind Skin: remove the Armature modifier (and, by default, the joint weight groups)
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 解除蒙皮绑定：移除骨架修改器，并默认删除关节权重组。

entries.english: Leave Paint Skin Weights and activate Maya's Select, Move, Rotate, or Scale tool
entries.suggested_chinese: 退出绘制蒙皮权重，启用 Maya 的选择、移动、旋转或缩放工具。

entries.english: Maya Paint Skin Weights: weight paint the skinned mesh with its skeleton posable (Ctrl+click picks a joint)
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 绘制蒙皮权重：对蒙皮网格进行权重绘制，同时允许调整骨架姿势；Ctrl + 单击选择关节。

entries.english: Flood the current operation and opacity into the active influence, respecting masks and locked weights
entries.suggested_chinese: 按当前操作和不透明度灌注活动影响对象的权重，同时遵守遮罩和锁定权重。

entries.english: Maya Copy Skin Weights: select the source mesh, then the destination
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 复制蒙皮权重：先选择源网格，再选择目标网格。

entries.english: Maya Mirror Skin Weights: copy one side's weights onto the other, joints paired by position
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 镜像蒙皮权重：将一侧权重复制到另一侧，按关节位置进行配对。

entries.english: Maya Copy Vertex Weights: remember the active vertex's joint weights
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 复制顶点权重：记录活动顶点的关节权重。

entries.english: Maya Paste Vertex Weights: give the selected vertices the copied joint weights
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 粘贴顶点权重：将复制的关节权重赋给选定顶点。

entries.english:
Maya Reset Default Weights: give the skinned mesh its bind weights again (closest distance, the joints it is
bound to, at most as many influences as each vertex has now, at least Maya's factory 5)
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 重置默认权重：按最近距离恢复蒙皮网格对已绑定关节的权重。每个顶点的最大影响数沿用其当前数量，但不低于 Maya 默认的 5。

entries.english:
Maya Skin > Move Skinned Joints: reposition the joints of a skinned skeleton without deforming the mesh (the
new place becomes the bind). Run it again, press F8 or pick another tool mode to go back to posing
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya“蒙皮 > 移动蒙皮关节”：重新放置已蒙皮骨架的关节而不使网格变形，新位置成为绑定位置。再次执行、按 F8 或切换工具模式，可返回姿态调整。

entries.english:
Maya Prune Small Weights: weights below the threshold leave the selected vertices (or the whole skin); the
rest are normalised. Locked joints keep theirs
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 修剪较小权重：移除所选顶点或整个蒙皮中低于阈值的权重，并将剩余权重规格化。锁定关节的权重保持不变。

entries.english:
Maya Set Max Influences: limit each vertex to this many joints (weights recomputed by distance; locked joints
keep theirs)
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 设置最大影响数：将每个顶点的关节影响数限制为指定数量，并按距离重新计算权重；锁定关节的权重保持不变。

entries.english: Maya Go to Bind Pose: every joint of the skeleton back to where it was when the skin was bound
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 转到绑定姿势：将骨架所有关节恢复到绑定蒙皮时的位置。

entries.english:
Maya Skin > Move Weights to Influences: on the selected vertices the target joints get the source joint's
weight and the source gets none (select the vertices, the source joint, then the targets)
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya“蒙皮 > 将权重移动到影响对象”：将选定顶点上源关节的权重转移给目标关节，并清除源关节权重。依次选择顶点、源关节和目标关节。

entries.english: Maya Skin > Normalize Weights > Disable / Enable / Enable Post: how the selected skins keep their weights
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya“蒙皮 > 规格化权重 > 禁用 / 启用 / 启用后期规格化”：控制选定蒙皮如何保持权重总和。

entries.english: Maya Skin > Export Weight Maps...: one grey image per joint in UV space and a .weightMap file listing them
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya“蒙皮 > 导出权重贴图”：为每个关节在 UV 空间写入一张灰度图，并生成列出这些图像的 .weightMap 文件。

entries.english: Maya Skin > Import Weights Maps...: set the skins' weights from a .weightMap file and its images
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya“蒙皮 > 导入权重贴图…”：根据 .weightMap 文件及其图像设置蒙皮权重。

entries.english:
Maya Skin > Substitute Geometry: the selected skinned mesh takes the other selected mesh's geometry and keeps
its skin (weights carried over by closest point)
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya“蒙皮 > 替换几何体”：选定蒙皮网格采用另一个选定网格的几何体，同时保留蒙皮，并按最近点转移权重。

entries.english:
Maya Skin > Bake Deformation to Skin Weights...: fit the destination skin's weights to the source mesh's whole
deformation (skin + deformers) over each joint's range of motion (select the source, then the destination)
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya“蒙皮 > 将变形烘焙到蒙皮权重”：先选源网格，再选目标网格；在各关节运动范围内，拟合目标蒙皮权重，使其匹配源网格的完整变形（蒙皮及变形器）。

entries.english: Maya units: new points farther from the old surface take the nearest old vertex's weights
entries.suggested_chinese: 以 Maya 单位计算：距离原表面更远的新点使用最近旧顶点的权重。

entries.english:
Move (and turn) the first selected object so its points land on the last selected
object's points (Maya Modify > Snap Align Objects > Point to Point / 2 / 3 Points)
entries.suggested_chinese: 移动并旋转第一选定对象，使其指定点对齐到最后选定对象上的点，对应 Maya“修改 > 吸附对齐对象 > 点到点 / 两点 / 三点”。

entries.english:
Line the selected objects up along world X at the middle of their bounding boxes
(Maya Modify > Snap Align Objects > Align Objects, factory options)
entries.suggested_chinese: 沿世界空间 X 轴按各对象边界框的中点对齐选定对象，对应 Maya“修改 > 吸附对齐对象 > 对齐对象”的默认选项。

entries.english:
Match the transforms of the selected objects to the last selected one
(Maya Modify > Match Transformations)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将选定对象的变换匹配到最后选定对象，对应 Maya“修改 > 匹配变换”。

entries.english:
Make the selected surface live: moves snap onto it. With nothing selected the live
surface is cleared (Maya Modify > Make Live)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将选定曲面设为活动曲面，使移动操作吸附到其上。未选择对象时清除活动曲面，对应 Maya“修改 > 使成为活动对象”。

entries.english:
Click a point on the object to move, then a point on the target: the object moves
there and turns so the surfaces face each other (Maya Modify > Snap Together Tool)
entries.suggested_chinese: 先单击要移动对象上的点，再单击目标上的点；对象移动到该处并旋转，使两表面相向，对应 Maya“修改 > 吸附到一起工具”。

entries.english:
Maya Step Snap of the Move / Rotate / Scale tool: off, relative to the start, or to
absolute steps (Discrete Move / Rotate / Snap Scale)
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 移动、旋转和缩放工具的步进吸附：可关闭、相对起点吸附，或吸附到绝对步长，对应离散移动、离散旋转及缩放吸附。

entries.english: Split the selected UVs so each face around them gets its own (Maya Cut/Sew > Split)
entries.suggested_chinese: 拆分选定 UV，使周围每个面拥有独立 UV，对应 Maya“剪切/缝合 > 拆分”。

entries.english:

entries.suggested_chinese: 将两个选定角点之间的四边面展开为覆盖 0–1 的栅格状 UV 壳，对应 Maya“剪切/缝合 > 创建壳（栅格）”。

entries.english: Cut seams so each UV shell can be unfolded (Maya Cut/Sew > Auto Seams; unfold afterwards)

entries.english: Rename the current UV set (Maya UV Sets > Rename Current UV Set...)
entries.suggested_chinese: 重命名当前 UV 集，对应 Maya“UV 集 > 重命名当前 UV 集…”。

entries.english: Copy the current UV set's UVs into another UV set (Maya UV Sets > Copy UVs to UV Set > <set>)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将当前 UV 集的 UV 复制到另一 UV 集，对应 Maya“UV 集 > 将 UV 复制到 UV 集 > 指定集”。

entries.english: Make this UV set the current one (Maya UV Sets > <set>)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将此 UV 集设为当前集，对应 Maya“UV 集 > <set>”。

entries.english: Space the selected UVs evenly between the outermost ones (Maya Distribute UVs)

entries.english:
Move each selected UV to the centre of its 1/256 grid cell (Maya Match Grid, factory 256 x 256, pixel
centres)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将各选定 UV 移到所属 1/256 网格单元的中心，对应 Maya“匹配栅格”；默认 256×256，吸附到像素中心。

entries.english:
Lay the selected shells out in one row along U, tallest first, scaled to fit the 0-1 square (Maya Layout
Along)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将选定 UV 壳沿 U 排成一行，按高度降序排列，并统一缩放以适应 0–1 区域，对应 Maya“沿方向布局”。

entries.english: Stack every selected shell that has the same shape as an earlier one onto it (Maya Stack Similar Shells)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将形状与前面某个壳相同的选定 UV 壳叠放到该壳上，对应 Maya“堆叠相似壳”。

entries.english:
Put the border UVs of the selected shells on the 0-1 square, spaced by the 3D edge lengths (Maya Map Border,
factory Square)
entries.suggested_chinese: 按三维边长比例将选定 UV 壳的边界 UV 均匀铺到 0–1 正方形边界，对应 Maya“映射边界”，默认形状为正方形。

entries.english:
Line up the selected border UVs between the two end ones (Maya Straighten Border; gaps of up to 5 UVs are
filled)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将两个端点之间的选定边界 UV 排成直线，对应 Maya“拉直边界”；自动填补不超过 5 个 UV 的选择间隙。

entries.english: Maya UV Editor Select > Unmapped Faces: the faces without UV area (deleted UVs collapse to (0, 0))
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya“UV 编辑器 > 选择 > 未映射的面”：选择没有 UV 面积的面；删除 UV 后，其坐标会坍缩到 (0, 0)。

entries.suggested_chinese: Maya UV 编辑器“编辑 > 取消全部固定”：取消这些网格上所有 UV 的固定。

entries.english: Maya UV Shell selection: the faces a box / lasso picks grow to their whole UV shells (passes the drag on)

entries.suggested_chinese: Maya UV 壳选择遮罩：单击选择整个 UV 壳。

entries.suggested_chinese: 将选定 UV 壳堆叠到其边界框中心，对应 Maya“堆叠 UV 壳”。

entries.english: Turn each selected UV shell to its narrowest bounding box, counter-clockwise (Maya Orient Shells)
entries.suggested_chinese: 逆时针旋转各选定 UV 壳，使其边界框最窄，对应 Maya“确定壳方向”。

entries.english: Turn each shell so its selected edge is horizontal or vertical (Maya Orient Shells to Edges)
entries.suggested_chinese: 旋转各 UV 壳，使其中选定边水平或垂直，对应 Maya“将壳定向到边”。

entries.english: Move the shells so their selected UVs meet at the centre of those UVs (Maya Snap and Stack)
entries.suggested_chinese: 移动 UV 壳，使其选定 UV 在这些 UV 的中心重合，对应 Maya“吸附并堆叠”。

entries.english: Move the first selected UV's shell so that UV lands on the second (Maya Snap Together)
entries.suggested_chinese: 移动第一选定 UV 所在的壳，使该 UV 对齐到第二个 UV，对应 Maya“一起吸附”。

entries.english: Line the selected shells up to the right, widest first, touching (Maya Distribute Shells)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将选定 UV 壳从左向右排列，宽的在前，相互接触，对应 Maya“分布 UV 壳”。

entries.english: Scale the selection's UVs to fill the 0-1 tile under them, u and v separately (Maya Normalize)
entries.suggested_chinese: 分别沿 U、V 缩放所选 UV，使其填满下方的 0–1 区块，对应 Maya“规格化”。

entries.english:
Spread the selected shells apart so none overlap, keeping their size and the group's centre

entries.suggested_chinese: 分散选定 UV 壳以消除重叠，同时保持各壳尺寸及整组中心，对应 Maya“取消堆叠壳”；底层使用不缩放的 Blender 岛打包。

entries.english: Move the smaller shell onto the other along the selected edges and sew them (Maya Move and Sew)
entries.suggested_chinese: 沿选定边将较小 UV 壳移动到另一 UV 壳并缝合，对应 Maya“移动并缝合”。

entries.english: Cut the UVs around the selected faces so they become their own shell (Maya Create UV Shell)
entries.suggested_chinese: 沿选定面的周界剪切 UV，使其成为独立 UV 壳，对应 Maya“创建 UV 壳”。

entries.english:

entries.suggested_chinese: 删除使用选定 UV 的所有面的 UV，对应 Maya“删除 UV”。Blender 必须为每个面角保留 UV，因此将其折叠到 0,0。

entries.english: Merge the selected UVs of each vertex that lie within the threshold (Maya UV > Merge UVs; factory 0.01)
entries.suggested_chinese: 合并同一顶点上距离在阈值内的选定 UV，对应 Maya“UV > 合并 UV”；默认阈值为 0.01。

entries.english:
Project UVs from several planes at once (Maya UV > Automatic): the selected faces, or every face of the
selected meshes in object mode
entries.suggested_chinese: 从多个平面同时投影 UV，对应 Maya“UV > 自动”；处理选定面，对象模式下处理选定网格的所有面。

entries.english:
Change the last UV > Automatic (Maya: edit the polyAutoProj node). Blender keeps no history, so only the
last one can be changed
entries.suggested_chinese: 修改最近一次“UV > 自动映射”，对应编辑 Maya polyAutoProj 节点。Blender 不保留该历史，因此只能修改最近一次操作。

entries.english:
Lay the selected faces out along their quad grid and stretch them to fill 0-1 (Maya UV > Contour Stretch;
Blender Follow Active Quads): every face of the selected meshes in object mode
entries.suggested_chinese: 沿四边面栅格排列选定面的 UV，并拉伸填满 0–1 空间，对应 Maya“UV > 轮廓拉伸”，由 Blender“沿活动四边面”实现；对象模式下处理选定网格的所有面。

entries.english: Cut the UVs along the selected edges (Maya Cut UV Edges): a seam, and the shells separate in place
entries.suggested_chinese: 沿选定边剪切 UV，对应 Maya“剪切 UV 边”；创建接缝，并在原位分离 UV 壳。

entries.english: Sew the UVs along the selected edges (Maya Sew UV Edges): the smaller shell moves onto the bigger one
entries.suggested_chinese: 沿选定边缝合 UV，对应 Maya“缝合 UV 边”；较小的壳移动到较大的壳上。

entries.english:
Unfold the selected UV shells (all when none are selected), keeping their borders and places
(Maya Unfold; Blender Unwrap, Minimum Stretch)
entries.suggested_chinese: 展开选定 UV 壳；未选择时处理全部 UV 壳，并保持其边界及位置。对应 Maya“展开”，由 Blender 的最小拉伸展开实现。

entries.english: Lay the selected UV shells (all when none are selected) out in 0-1 (Maya Layout; Blender Pack Islands)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将选定 UV 壳排列到 0–1 空间；未选择时处理全部 UV 壳。对应 Maya“布局”，由 Blender 打包 UV 岛实现。

entries.english: Measure the texel density of the selected UV shells (all when none are selected): pixels per Maya unit
entries.suggested_chinese: 测量选定 UV 壳的纹素密度，即每 Maya 单位的像素数；没有选定壳时测量全部壳。

entries.english: Scale the selected UV shells (all when none are selected) to the texel density (pixels per Maya unit)
entries.suggested_chinese: 将选定 UV 壳缩放到指定纹素密度，单位为每 Maya 单位的像素数；未选择时处理全部 UV 壳。

entries.english:
Maya UV components: open the UV Editor (once) and pick Vertex / Edge / Face / UV / UV Shell there.
Blender picks UVs in the UV Editor only
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya UV 组件选择：首次打开 UV 编辑器，然后选择顶点、边、面、UV 或 UV 壳。Blender 只能在 UV 编辑器中选择 UV。

entries.english: Texture size in pixels for Texel Density and Layout padding
entries.suggested_chinese: 用于纹素密度和布局间距计算的纹理像素尺寸。

entries.english: Pixels per Maya unit (px/cm in the Maya Workflow Kit template)
entries.suggested_chinese: 每 Maya 单位的像素数；插件模板中为像素/厘米。

entries.english: Tumble the view (Maya Alt+LMB); locked in axis-aligned ortho views
entries.suggested_chinese: 翻滚视图，对应 Maya Alt+鼠标左键；轴对齐的正交视图中锁定。

entries.english: Dolly the view in / out with a left / right drag (Maya Alt+RMB)
entries.suggested_chinese: 向左或向右拖动推拉视图，对应 Maya Alt + 鼠标右键。

entries.english: Zoom the UV / Image Editor in / out with a left / right drag (Maya Alt+RMB dolly)
entries.suggested_chinese: 向左或向右拖动以缩小或放大 UV/图像编辑器，对应 Maya Alt + 鼠标右键推拉。

entries.english: Tumble or track the view along one axis only (Maya Alt+Shift+drag)
entries.suggested_chinese: 仅沿单一轴翻滚或平移视图，对应 Maya Alt + Shift + 拖动。

entries.english: Frame the selection (or everything) in this view with Maya's fit (F, A, Ctrl+Shift+F)
entries.suggested_chinese: 按 Maya 的适配方式在当前视图框显选择或全部内容，对应 F、A、Ctrl+Shift+F。

entries.english:
Frame the selection (or everything) in every 3D view (Maya Shift+F / Shift+A /
Ctrl+Shift+F)
entries.suggested_chinese: 在所有三维视图中框显选定对象或全部对象，对应 Maya Shift+F / Shift+A / Ctrl+Shift+F。

entries.english: Undo or redo a view change (Maya [ and ]); separate from scene undo
entries.suggested_chinese: 撤消或重做视图变化，对应 Maya 的 [ 和 ]；独立于场景撤消。

entries.english:
Toggle the four view; leaving it keeps the panel under the cursor (Maya Space tap). Four real panels, each
with its own camera, shading and Show settings (ui/four_view.py, step 237)
entries.suggested_chinese: 切换四视图，退出时保留鼠标下的面板，对应 Maya 轻按空格。四个独立面板分别保存摄影机、着色和显示设置。

entries.english: Go to the default view (Maya Home)
entries.suggested_chinese: 返回默认视图，对应 Maya Home。

entries.english: Emulate 3 Button Mouse is on (Preferences > Input): Blender turns Alt+left drag into a middle drag before any key map sees it, so Maya's Alt+LMB tumble can't work. Turn it off for Maya navigation (Alt+MMB track and Alt+RMB dolly work either way).

entries.english: Other tools give you one piece at a time: a pivot, a keymap, a shelf, a theme. Maya Workflow Kit brings the whole Maya workflow into Blender in one install: hotbox and marking menus, Channel Box, Attribute Editor, Outliner, menu sets, shelves, option windows, Freeze / History concepts, centimetre units and pCube1-style naming.
entries.suggested_chinese: 其他工具通常分别提供枢轴、快捷键配置、工具架或主题。Maya Workflow Kit 将整套 Maya 工作流带入 Blender：热盒、标记菜单、通道盒、属性编辑器、大纲视图、菜单集、工具架、选项窗口、冻结变换和构建历史概念、厘米单位，以及 pCube1 风格的命名。

entries.english: In Pose mode the arrow keys walk past bones whose bone collections are all hidden (Rigify MCH / DEF / ORG bones), to the nearest shown parent, child or sibling; a generated Rigify rig follows its controls' ORG hierarchy (upper_arm_fk.L Up = shoulder.L). Maya walks into hidden nodes: bones hidden one by one (H) are still walked into, and an armature with controller tags (Control > Tag As Controller) follows its controller hierarchy instead. Off: plain hierarchy

entries.suggested_chinese: Maya 在此列出场景烘焙集；Blender 在“渲染属性 > 烘焙”中进行烘焙，需使用 Cycles。

entries.english: Blender has no volume capsules to drag: Bind Skin gives Maya's closest-distance weights, then paint them (Skin > Paint Skin Weights).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有可拖动的体积胶囊绑定方式。绑定蒙皮先生成 Maya 风格的最近距离权重，再通过“蒙皮 > 绘制蒙皮权重”调整。

entries.english: The marking menus are the kit's Maya layouts; Blender has no editor for them (Preferences > Keymap edits which key opens which menu).
entries.suggested_chinese: 标记菜单采用插件预设的 Maya 布局，Blender 没有对应编辑器；可在“偏好设置 > 键位映射”中修改打开菜单的按键。

entries.draft_origin: 本地 Maya 术语草稿

entries.english: The shelves are Maya's factory shelves; there is no shelf editor (right-click a Blender button > Add to Quick Favorites keeps your own commands).
entries.suggested_chinese: 工具架采用 Maya 默认工具架布局，未提供工具架编辑器；可右键单击 Blender 按钮并选择“添加到快速收藏”，保留自定义命令。

entries.draft_origin: 本地 Blender 整句译文

entries.english: Blender saves panel layouts as workspaces: drag area edges and save the file or use Windows > Workspaces.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 将面板布局保存为工作区；拖动编辑区边界并保存文件，或使用“窗口 > 工作区”。

entries.english: Blender snaps onto every surface, not only the live one: Make Live turns face snapping on and names the surface in the Status Line.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 会吸附到所有曲面，而不仅是活动曲面。“使成为活动对象”启用面吸附，并在状态行显示指定曲面的名称。

entries.english: Blender has one pivot (the origin), so only the pivot orientation is baked into Rotate; the position already is the object's pivot.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 仅有一个枢轴，即原点。因此仅将枢轴方向烘焙到旋转值；枢轴位置本来就是对象枢轴。

entries.draft_origin: 本地 Blender 整句译文

entries.english: Blender has no Trax: clips are actions laid out as NLA strips.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有 Trax；通过排列在 NLA 轨道中的动作片段实现动画片段。

entries.english: Blender has no Time Editor: clips are actions laid out as NLA strips.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有时间编辑器；片段通过排列在 NLA 轨道中的动作片段实现。

entries.draft_origin: 本地 Blender 整句译文

entries.english: Blender playback always loops (no Once / Oscillate).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 始终循环播放，不支持仅一次或往返播放。

entries.draft_origin: 本地 Maya 术语草稿
按设置动作拟译；需连同界面位置审阅

entries.english: Blender has no partitions (sets whose members can't be in another set of the partition): use Create > Sets > Set.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有划分，即成员在同一划分内只能属于其中一个集的机制；请使用“创建 > 集 > 集”。

entries.draft_origin: 本地 Blender 整句译文

entries.english: Blender has no node graph of attribute connections: attribute links are drivers (Expression Editor), material nodes are in the Shader Editor (Hypershade).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有统一显示属性连接的节点图：属性连接使用驱动器，由表达式编辑器处理；材质节点位于着色器编辑器，即本插件的 Hypershade 对应界面。

entries.draft_origin: 本地 Maya 术语草稿

entries.english: Blender has no Hypergraph: the Outliner shows the hierarchy.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有 Hypergraph；可在大纲视图中查看层次。

entries.draft_origin: 本地 Blender 整句译文

entries.english: Blender has no connection graph: attribute links are drivers (Expression Editor).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有连接图；属性连接通过驱动器实现，由表达式编辑器处理。

entries.english: Blender has no namespaces: Maya Workflow Kit keeps them as a "ns:" prefix in names.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有命名空间；Maya Workflow Kit 通过对象名称中的“ns:”前缀保留命名空间。

entries.english: Blender has no Light Editor: Maya Workflow Kit lists the scene lights in a 3D View sidebar tab (Exposure is part of Power).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有灯光编辑器；本工具包在三维视图侧栏中列出场景灯光，曝光作为功率的一部分处理。
着色器编辑器与插件列表

entries.english: Blender has no Hypershade: the Shader Editor is the graph, its Hypershade sidebar tab the browser (add nodes with Shift+A).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有 Hypershade：使用着色器编辑器显示节点图，Hypershade 侧栏显示浏览器；按 Shift+A 添加节点。

entries.english: Blender has no batch render queue: Maya Workflow Kit renders a copy of the scene in a separate background Blender (blender -b ... -a).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有批渲染队列。Maya Workflow Kit 会在独立的后台 Blender 进程中渲染场景副本，使用 blender -b ... -a。

entries.english: Blender has no NURBS square: four straight NURBS curves under an empty, like Maya's group.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有 NURBS 方形：使用空对象下的四条直线 NURBS 曲线组成，类似 Maya 的组。

entries.english: Blender has no NURBS cube: six NURBS surface patches under an empty, like Maya's group.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有 NURBS 立方体：使用空对象下的六个 NURBS 曲面面片组成，类似 Maya 的组。

entries.draft_origin: 本地相同整句（仅大小写/空白差异）

entries.english: Blender has no NURBS cone: a NURBS cylinder with its top row of points closed.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有 NURBS 圆锥体；通过将 NURBS 圆柱体顶端一排控制点闭合来实现。

entries.english: Blender's Draw tool on a new curve in Edit Mode: drag to draw (on the 3D cursor's plane).
entries.suggested_chinese: 在新曲线的编辑模式中使用 Blender 绘制工具，拖动以在三维游标所在平面绘制。

entries.english: Blender makes the mesh from a copy of the curve with a round bevel (8 sides); no live profile options.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 通过给曲线副本添加八边形圆形倒角并转换来创建网格，不提供实时截面选项。

entries.english: Blender extrudes the curve's end points: move the mouse, click to place the new point.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 挤出曲线端点：移动鼠标后单击，放置新点。

entries.english: Blender's offset copy is a poly curve through the moved points, not a fitted NURBS curve.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 的偏移副本是穿过偏移后各点的多段线曲线，不是拟合的 NURBS 曲线。

entries.english: Blender fills closed 2D curves: a copy of the curve, flattened onto its own XY plane.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 通过填充闭合二维曲线生成曲面：使用曲线副本，并将其展平到自身 XY 平面。
曲线挤出及倒角后转换

entries.english: Blender builds a mesh from the filled curve, extruded and bevelled both ways around the curve's plane.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 根据填充后的曲线生成网格，并沿曲线平面两侧挤出和倒角。

entries.english: Blender has no stamp spray brush: Draw Sharp is the closest (also sculpt Ctrl+8).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有图章喷绘笔刷；“锐化绘制”最接近，也可在雕刻模式按 Ctrl + 8 使用。

entries.english: Blender has no repeating stamp brush: Layer is the closest (also sculpt Ctrl+9).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有重复印章笔刷；最接近的是“层”笔刷，也可在雕刻模式按 Ctrl+9 使用。

entries.draft_origin: 本地 Blender 整句译文

entries.english: Blender makes the selected meshes smoke flows inside a new Mantaflow domain.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 将选定网格设为烟雾流源，并创建新的 Mantaflow 模拟域包围它们。

entries.english: Blender gives the selected meshes a Fluid modifier of type Effector.
entries.suggested_chinese: 为选定网格添加类型为“效果器”的流体修改器。

entries.english: Blender shows the input mesh by turning the Cloth modifier off in the viewport.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 通过在视口中关闭布料修改器来显示输入网格。

entries.english: Blender shows the simulated mesh with the Cloth modifier on in the viewport.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 通过在视口中启用布料修改器来显示模拟结果网格。

entries.english: Blender hair is a Curves object groomed in Sculpt mode: on the selected mesh the kit adds an empty hair object (or picks its hair) and switches to it; paint follicles with the Add brush.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 毛发是可在雕刻模式下梳理的曲线对象。插件在选定网格上创建空毛发对象，或选择其已有毛发并切换过去；使用“添加”笔刷绘制毛囊。

entries.english: Blender faces can't have holes: the stamp outline is bridged to the face's border with quads (select the face to cut, then the stamp face).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 的单个面不能含洞；工具会用四边面将印模轮廓桥接到目标面的边界。先选择待切割面，再选择印模面。

entries.english: Blender's IK bends from the rest pose: the angle is stored for Assume Preferred Angle, the solver doesn't read it.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 的 IK 从静止姿势计算弯曲。角度会保存供“采用首选角度”使用，但 IK 解算器不会读取该值。

entries.draft_origin: 本地相同整句（仅大小写/空白差异）

entries.english: Blender makes a Spline IK constraint on the end bone and the curve curve1; there is no ikHandle / effector node.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 在末端骨骼上创建样条线 IK 约束，并创建 curve1 曲线；没有 ikHandle / effector 节点。

entries.english: Blender always lets you rotate joints in an IK chain: the rotation shows where the handle's Ik Blend is 0 (Key > IK/FK Keys).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 始终允许旋转 IK 链中的关节；当控制柄的 Ik Blend 为 0 时显示该旋转，对应“关键帧 > IK/FK 关键帧”。
IK 混合及关节关键帧

entries.english: Keys the handle (Ik Blend included) and the chain joints' solved rotation; Blender has no handle Offset channel to key.
entries.suggested_chinese: 为控制柄（包括 Ik Blend）及关节链求解后的旋转设置关键帧。Blender 没有可供设置关键帧的控制柄 Offset 通道。

entries.draft_origin: 本地相同整句（仅大小写/空白差异）

entries.english: Blender's cluster is a Hook modifier driven by the clusterNHandle empty.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 中的簇使用钩挂修改器，由 clusterNHandle 空对象驱动。

entries.english: Blender's soft modification is a Hook modifier on the whole mesh with Maya's falloff (radius 5, smooth), driven by softModNHandle.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 中的软修改使用作用于整个网格的钩挂修改器，由 softModNHandle 驱动，并采用 Maya 衰减设置：半径 5、平滑衰减。

entries.english: Blender's IPR is the viewport in Rendered shading (Render Region: Ctrl+B).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 的交互式渲染是视口的渲染着色模式；Ctrl+B 可设置渲染区域。

entries.english: Blender particles come from a mesh: Maya Workflow Kit makes a one-point mesh emitter1 with the particles, sized in Maya units.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 粒子从网格发射。本工具包创建名为 emitter1 的单顶点网格作为粒子发射器，并使用 Maya 单位确定尺寸。

entries.draft_origin: 本地相同整句（仅大小写/空白差异）

entries.english: Blender cloth simulates real sizes: Maya Workflow Kit scales collision distances, stiffness and gravity so one unit moves like Maya's (nucleus Space Scale in the Attribute Editor).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 布料按真实尺寸模拟。本插件缩放碰撞距离、刚度和重力，使一个单位呈现 Maya 的运动尺度；可在属性编辑器的 nucleus“空间比例”中调整。

entries.english: Blender always plays a baked cache: Delete Cache to simulate again.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 始终播放已烘焙缓存；如需重新模拟，请删除缓存。
启用选定对象的全部缓存
禁用选定对象的所有缓存

entries.english: Maya Decay Rate No Decay renders in Cycles; Blender EEVEE and the viewport get darker with the square of the distance, the power matching Maya intensity 1 at 10 units.
entries.suggested_chinese: Maya“无衰减”在 Cycles 中生效。EEVEE 和视口仍按距离平方衰减；其功率按 10 单位处对应 Maya 强度 1 校准。

entries.english: Blender's area light falls off like Maya's; its power matches Maya intensity 1 (2 x 2 units).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 区域光的衰减方式与 Maya 相似；2×2 单位大小时，功率按 Maya 强度 1 校准。

entries.english: Blender has no ambient light: the World colour gives the flat part and a point light the Ambient Shade part; surfaces turned away from the light get more light than in Maya.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有环境光类型：世界颜色提供均匀环境部分，点光源提供环境着色部分；背光面的亮度会高于 Maya 中的结果。

entries.english: Point light cut at the sphere
entries.suggested_chinese: 以球形范围裁切点光源

entries.english: Blender has no volume light: a point light at the centre cut at the sphere (the object's scale); Cycles renders Maya's falloff, EEVEE and the viewport approximate it.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有体积光：此处使用中心点光源，并在由对象缩放确定的球面处截断。Cycles 实现 Maya 的衰减，EEVEE 和视口采用近似效果。

entries.english: Blender has no HumanIK / Quick Rig: the bundled Rigify add-on builds a rig from a meta-rig fitted to the mesh (Generate Rig).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有 HumanIK 或 Quick Rig；附带的 Rigify 插件通过贴合网格的元骨架生成绑定，使用“生成绑定”。
窗口/动画编辑器/快速绑定

entries.english: Blender references are linked .blend files: Maya Workflow Kit makes them editable (library override) and prefixes the names with the namespace (ns:name).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 引用采用链接的 .blend 文件。本工具包通过库覆盖使其可编辑，并添加命名空间前缀，例如 ns:name。

entries.english: Blender has no projects: Maya Workflow Kit keeps this folder, opens file dialogs in its scenes folder and renders to its images folder.

entries.english: Blender has no projects: Maya Workflow Kit makes Maya's project folders and keeps the folder as your project.

entries.english: Blender stores creases as 0-1 (1 = fully sharp). The kit shows Maya's value (sharp for that many smooth levels) and stores sqrt(value / 10); see it with 3 (smooth mesh preview).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 以 0–1 保存折痕，1 表示完全锐利。本工具包显示 Maya 折痕值，即保持锐利的平滑级数，并存储 sqrt(value / 10)；按 3 使用平滑网格预览查看。
