entries.english: Blender's NURBS surfaces can't be trimmed and have no Fillet, Stitch or surface Booleans (Maya Workflow Kit builds Loft, Revolve, Extrude, Birail 1, Boundary, Square, Attach, Detach, Rebuild and Reverse as NURBS surfaces): edit CVs in Edit Mode or model with polygons.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 的 NURBS 曲面不能修剪，也不支持圆角、缝合或曲面布尔。插件可生成放样、旋转、挤出、双轨成形 1、边界、方形、附加、分离、重建和反转 NURBS 曲面；其他操作请在编辑模式调整控制顶点，或使用多边形建模。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no Paint Effects: draw strokes with Grease Pencil, scatter geometry with Geometry Nodes.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有 Paint Effects；可用蜡笔绘制笔划，用几何节点散布几何体。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no character web service: model or import the character.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有角色网页服务；请自行建模或导入角色。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no ReCap link: import point clouds / meshes from files (PLY, OBJ).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有 ReCap 链接；请通过 PLY、OBJ 等文件导入点云或网格。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender hair = Curves objects groomed in Sculpt mode; there are no follicles or nHair dynamics (use the Hair Dynamics node group).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 毛发是可在雕刻模式中梳理的曲线对象，不具有 Maya 毛囊或 nHair 动力学；可使用 Hair Dynamics 节点组。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Cloth pin group / Rigid Body Constraint
entries.suggested_chinese: 布料固定顶点组 / 刚体约束

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no nConstraints: pin cloth with a vertex group (Cloth > Shape > Pin Group), connect rigid bodies with Rigid Body Constraints.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有 nConstraint。布料可通过“布料 > 形状 > 固定顶点组”固定；刚体之间可使用刚体约束连接。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender cloth is a Cloth modifier (Physics properties): rest shape, output space and texture maps are not separate nodes.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 布料使用物理属性中的布料修改器；静止形状、输出空间和纹理贴图不是独立节点。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender caches each simulation in its Physics properties (Bake / Free Bake): merging, replacing or editing cache frames isn't available.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 在各模拟的物理属性中烘焙或释放缓存，不支持合并、替换或编辑缓存帧。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender particles are a particle system on a mesh: instancing = Render As Object / Collection; there are no goals, sprite wizard or collision events.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 粒子是网格上的粒子系统；实例化通过“渲染为对象/集合”实现，不支持 Maya 的目标、精灵向导或碰撞事件。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender fluids are Mantaflow domains (Physics > Fluid): no 2D containers, contents painting, ponds or boats; Ocean is a modifier.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 流体使用“物理 > 流体”中的 Mantaflow 模拟域，不提供二维容器、内容绘制、池塘或船；海洋由修改器实现。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender fields are Force Field objects; rigid body solvers, keys and initial states are in Scene > Rigid Body World and each Physics tab.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 的场使用力场对象；刚体解算器、关键帧和初始状态位于“场景 > 刚体世界”及各对象的物理属性中。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's Object > Quick Effects has Smoke, Fire, Liquid and Explode; Fireworks, Lightning, Shatter and Flow aren't built in (Cell Fracture extension for Shatter).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender“对象 > 快速效果”提供烟雾、火焰、液体和爆炸，不内置烟花、闪电、破碎或流动效果；破碎可使用 Cell Fracture 扩展。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender toon lines are Line Art (Grease Pencil) or Freestyle; line attributes are Line Art modifiers, not painted maps.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 卡通轮廓线使用蜡笔线条艺术或 Freestyle；线属性由线条艺术修改器控制，不使用绘制贴图。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 着色器转 RGB 材质

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender toon fills are materials with Shader to RGB + a Color Ramp (EEVEE).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 的卡通填充由 Shader to RGB 与颜色渐变构成的材质实现，仅适用于 EEVEE。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender stereo = Render > Stereoscopy with the camera's Stereoscopy settings: there are no stereo rigs or camera links.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 立体显示通过“渲染 > 立体视觉”和摄影机的立体视觉设置实现，不提供立体绑定或摄影机链接。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender sounds are Video Sequencer strips (waveforms show in the Sequencer); No sounds available is greyed in Maya too.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 的声音是视频序列编辑器中的音频片段，波形也在序列编辑器显示；Maya 没有可用声音时同样会禁用此项目。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender plays geometry caches as Alembic files in a Mesh Sequence Cache modifier: replacing, merging or editing cache frames isn't available.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 通过网格序列缓存修改器播放 Alembic 几何体缓存，不支持替换、合并或编辑缓存帧。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's Alembic import already keeps the file linked (Mesh Sequence Cache); replace = import again, About = the Blender manual.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 导入 Alembic 时已通过网格序列缓存保留文件链接；“替换”相当于重新导入，“关于”打开 Blender 手册。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no GPU cache node: reload an imported Alembic from its Cache File properties.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有 GPU 缓存节点；可在缓存文件属性中重新加载已导入的 Alembic。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no Autodesk account, product research or analytics services; Blender's Help menu has the manual and bug reports.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有 Autodesk 账户、产品研究或分析服务。“帮助”菜单提供手册和错误报告入口。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no HumanIK control rigs, character mapping or redirection: bone collections group the controls. Character sets: Control > Create Character Set.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有 HumanIK 控制绑定、角色映射或重定向，可通过骨骼集合组织控制器。角色集请使用“控制 > 创建角色集”。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no character mapping or redirection: retarget with Copy Transforms constraints. Character sets: Key > Create Character Set.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有角色映射或重定向功能，可用复制变换约束重定目标；角色集位于“关键帧 > 创建角色集”。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no Connect to IK/FK: drive the handle's Ik Blend from a control with Key > Set Driven Key or a driver.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有“连接到 IK/FK”。可使用“关键帧 > 设置驱动关键帧”或驱动器，由控制器驱动控制柄的 Ik Blend。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no scene time warp: remap time per action with an NLA strip's Scale / Repeat or a Time Offset modifier.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有场景时间扭曲。可使用 NLA 片段的缩放、重复，或时间偏移修改器，分别重映射各动作的时间。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 骨架编辑模式 / 姿态模式

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender: IK handles are IK constraints (switch with Influence), joints are bone heads edited in armature edit mode.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 中的 IK 控制柄使用 IK 约束实现，通过影响系数切换；关节对应骨骼头部，在骨架编辑模式下编辑。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender deformers are modifiers (Properties > Modifiers) with vertex-group weights: no deformer sets or tweak nodes.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 变形器是使用顶点组权重的修改器，位于“属性 > 修改器”；没有变形器集或微调节点。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender shows motion with Motion Paths (Object properties); there is no turntable camera rig or animated sweep surface (the kit has Animation Snapshot and ghosting).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 通过对象属性中的运动路径显示运动；没有转台摄影机绑定或动画扫描曲面。本插件提供动画快照和重影。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's playback options are in the Timeline's Playback popover; there is no cached-playback toggle or stepped preview.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 播放选项位于时间轴“播放”弹出面板；没有缓存播放开关或阶跃预览。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's render settings are in Properties > Render / Output: render diagnostics, Backburner and NURBS tessellation have no counterpart.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 渲染设置位于“属性 > 渲染 / 输出”；渲染诊断、Backburner 和 NURBS 镶嵌没有对应功能。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 着色器编辑器 / 纹理绘制

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no PSD networks or texture reference objects: textures are image nodes in the Shader Editor, painted in Texture Paint mode.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有 PSD 网络或纹理参考对象。纹理是着色器编辑器中的图像节点，可在纹理绘制模式下绘制。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender transfers maps between meshes with Cycles Bake (Render properties > Bake, Selected to Active).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 通过 Cycles 烘焙在网格间传递贴图，使用“渲染属性 > 烘焙 > 从选定对象到活动对象”。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender instances share mesh data (Alt+D, Object > Link/Transfer Data); per-instance attributes aren't available.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 实例共享网格数据，可通过 Alt+D 或“对象 > 链接/传递数据”创建；不支持逐实例属性。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender: paint reduce / transfer weights = vertex groups on Decimate / Data Transfer modifiers.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 中的绘制简化权重和传递权重，分别对应简化修改器、数据传递修改器上的顶点组。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no Spray / Repeat / Imprint stamps or Maya sculpt targets: use a textured Draw brush, or sculpt on a shape key.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有喷绘、重复、印记图章或 Maya 雕刻目标。请使用带纹理的绘制笔刷，或在形态键上雕刻。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 对象 > 链接/传递数据

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no attribute clipboard or vertex-order transfer: Object > Link/Transfer Data copies data between objects.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有属性剪贴板或顶点顺序传递；可通过“对象 > 链接/传递数据”在对象间复制数据。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's smooth proxy is the Subdivision Surface modifier: there is no mirror proxy.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 平滑代理通过细分曲面修改器实现，不提供镜像代理。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender: invisible faces = delete or hide faces, reorder vertices = Mesh > Sort Elements, project a curve = Knife Project.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 中，不可见面通过删除或隐藏面实现；重排顶点可用“网格 > 排序元素”，曲线投影可用切割投影。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: The kit creates primitives at the origin at once; Blender has no interactive (drag to size) creation.
entries.suggested_chinese: 本插件立即在原点创建基本体；Blender 没有通过拖动设置尺寸的交互式创建。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's NURBS primitives are in Add > Surface (no cube, cone or square); objects are created at once, never interactively.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender NURBS 基本体位于“添加 > 曲面”，不包含立方体、圆锥体或方形；对象会立即创建，不支持交互式拖动创建。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no volume primitives: a Volume object or a Mesh to Volume modifier.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有体积基本体；可使用体积对象或“网格转体积”修改器。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's Measure tool measures distances and angles; parameter and arc length tools aren't built in.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 测量工具可测量距离和角度，不内置参数测量和弧长测量工具。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender assets are data-blocks marked as assets (Asset Browser), not containers.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 资产是标记为资产的数据块，可在资产浏览器中访问，不是容器。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's scene assemblies are collection instances (Add > Collection Instance).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 场景装配对应集合实例，可通过“添加 > 集合实例”创建。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no selection by this type or constraint: Select All by Type, Select Linked and Select Similar are the closest.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 不支持按此类型或约束选择。最接近的功能是按类型全部选择、选择相连项和选择相似项。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no vertex-face component: per-corner normals and colours follow the selected faces (Mesh > Normals > Set from Faces); single corners are picked in the UV Editor with Sticky Selection off.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有顶点面组件：逐面角法线和颜色随选定面处理，可使用“网格 > 法线 > 根据面设置”。要选择单个面角，请在 UV 编辑器中关闭粘连选择。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no command by this name: see Object > Transform / Apply / Snap.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有此名称的命令，请查看“对象 > 变换 / 应用 / 吸附”。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 资产浏览器 / 库覆盖

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no assets with published attributes: mark data-blocks as assets, expose values with library overrides or custom properties.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有带发布属性的资产。可将数据块标记为资产，并通过库覆盖或自定义属性提供可编辑值。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender converts curves, text, meshes and Grease Pencil; subdiv surfaces, Paint Effects, displacement and fluids aren't separate types.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 可转换曲线、文本、网格和蜡笔；细分曲面、Paint Effects、置换和流体不是独立对象类型。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's manipulator is the active tool's gizmo: there is no Type Manipulator.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 操纵器是活动工具的控制器，不支持 Maya 的类型操纵器。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no LOD groups, fur or attribute-value transfer: Object > Link/Transfer Data copies data between objects.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有对应的 LOD 组、绒毛或属性值传递功能。“对象 > 链接/传递数据”可在对象之间复制数据。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no ATOM files or After Effects Live Link: move animation with Append / Link or FBX / Alembic export.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 不支持 ATOM 文件或 After Effects 实时链接。可使用追加、链接，或 FBX / Alembic 导出传递动画。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender draws this through the Viewport Overlays popover or Object properties > Viewport Display; there is no per-camera visibility.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 通过“视口叠加层”弹出面板，或“对象属性 > 视口显示”绘制此项，不支持逐摄影机可见性。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no editor by this name: any area's editor-type menu gives the closest editor.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有此名称的编辑器。可通过任意区域的编辑器类型菜单选择最接近的编辑器。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no XGen: hair is a Curves object groomed in Sculpt mode with Geometry Nodes hair modifiers.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有 XGen。毛发是曲线对象，在雕刻模式下梳理，并使用几何节点毛发修改器。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender mixes vertex colors into materials with a Color Attribute node in the Shader Editor, not a per-object setting.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 通过着色器编辑器中的颜色属性节点，将顶点颜色混入材质，而不是使用逐对象设置。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender selects curve and surface control points in edit mode (Tab); hulls, isoparms and edit points aren't separate components.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 在编辑模式（Tab）下选择曲线和曲面的控制点；控制壳、等参线和编辑点不是独立组件。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no node of this type: delete it in the Outliner, or File > Clean Up > Purge for unused data.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有此类独立节点。请在大纲视图中删除，或使用“文件 > 清理 > 清除孤立数据”清理未使用的数据。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender windows are managed by the OS (Window > Toggle Window Fullscreen); there is no Home screen.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 窗口由操作系统管理，可使用“窗口 > 切换窗口全屏”；没有主屏幕。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 对象属性 > 视口显示

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender sets this per object, not per view: Object Properties > Viewport Display > Display As (Bounds / Wire / Solid).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 按对象而非按视图设置此项，位于“对象属性 > 视口显示 > 显示为”，可选边界框、线框或实体。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's views filter by object type only (mesh, curve, light, camera, empty ...): this Maya node type has no type of its own, so it shows with its object type.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 视图仅按网格、曲线、灯光、摄影机、空对象等对象类型过滤。此 Maya 节点没有独立对象类型，会随所属对象类型一起显示。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no camera sequencer view time: bind scene cameras to timeline markers (Ctrl+B in the Timeline) or cut camera strips in the Video Sequencer.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有摄影机序列编辑器的视图时间。可在时间轴中用 Ctrl + B 将场景摄影机绑定到标记，或在视频序列编辑器中剪辑摄影机片段。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no 2D pan / zoom of the film back: move the camera's Shift X / Y (Attribute Editor > Film Offset) or zoom in the camera view (wheel).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 不支持片门的二维平移/缩放。可调整摄影机 Shift X / Y，即“属性编辑器 > 片门偏移”，或在摄影机视图中使用滚轮缩放。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 翻滚工具 / Alt + 鼠标左键

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no azimuth / elevation camera tool: tumble with Alt+LMB or the Tumble Tool.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有摄影机方位角/仰角工具；可通过 Alt+鼠标左键或翻滚工具旋转视图。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 行走工具 / 飞行工具

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no yaw-pitch tool: turn the camera in place with the Walk or Fly Tool.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有偏航俯仰工具；可使用步行或飞行工具原地转动摄影机。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender shades a whole view one way (Solid / Wireframe), not per selected object.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 对整个视图统一使用实体或线框着色，不能按选定对象分别指定。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender shades faces from the mesh normals in every view; there is no faceted display mode (Lighting > Use Flat Lighting is the nearest view setting).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 在所有视图中都按网格法线对面着色，没有分面显示模式；最接近的视图设置是“照明 > 使用平直照明”。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender shades faces from the mesh normals in every view; there is no per-object faceted display mode.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 在所有视图中按网格法线着色，不支持为单个对象指定分面显示模式。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's views have no points-only display mode: Wireframe is the nearest (Object Properties > Viewport Display > Display As shows one object as Bounds / Wire).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 视图没有仅点显示模式，最接近的是线框。在“对象属性 > 视口显示 > 显示为”中可将单个对象显示为边界框或线框。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender X-rays the whole view (X-Ray), not only the components being edited.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 的 X 射线作用于整个视图，而不只作用于正在编辑的组件。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender keeps the view's shading while you tumble (no wireframe fallback): nothing to switch.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 翻滚视图时保持原有着色，不会退回线框模式，因此没有相应开关。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender always draws anti-aliased wires (a preference: Viewport > Quality > Anti-Aliasing).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 始终绘制抗锯齿线框；可在“偏好设置 > 视口 > 质量 > 抗锯齿”中设置。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's viewport has no fog: the render's Mist pass (View Layer properties) gives depth fog.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 视口没有雾效果；视图层属性中的渲染“迷雾”通道可生成深度雾。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 使用全部灯光，并隐藏灯光（h）

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender lights a view with every visible scene light and has no per-view light list: hide the lights you don't want (h) or use light linking (Object Properties > Shading).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 使用所有可见场景灯光照亮视图，没有逐视图灯光列表。可按 h 隐藏不需要的灯光，或使用“对象属性 > 着色”中的灯光链接。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's views always light the scene (studio, flat or scene lights): Use Flat Lighting shows the plain colours.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 视图始终使用演播室、平直或场景灯光照明。“使用平直照明”显示未经灯光变化的颜色。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender always lights both sides of a face in the viewport (Backface Culling hides back faces).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 视口始终对面的两侧照明；背面剔除可隐藏背面。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 对象属性 > 可见性 > 阻隔

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender holdouts are a render setting per object / collection; views don't filter them.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 阻隔是逐对象或集合的渲染设置，视图不能按该类型过滤。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has one viewport renderer (Workbench / EEVEE), listed as Viewport 2.0 and the render engine.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 只有一套视口渲染显示机制，使用 Workbench 或 EEVEE，此处以“视口 2.0”和渲染引擎列出。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 渲染属性 > 立体视觉

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's stereo is a scene setting (Stereoscopy, Views) shown in a stereo window mode, not a panel type.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 的立体显示是场景设置，通过“立体视觉”和“视图”配置，并以立体窗口模式显示；它不是面板类型。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no camera sets: bind cameras to timeline markers to switch between them.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有摄影机集；可将摄影机绑定到时间轴标记来切换。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 大纲视图 / 节点编辑器

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no Hypergraph: hierarchy is in the Outliner, node networks in the Node Editor (Panels > Panel).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有超级图。大纲视图显示层次，节点编辑器显示节点网络，可通过“面板 > 面板”切换。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender saves layouts as workspaces (Windows > Workspaces, the Status Line drop-down).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 将布局保存为工作区，可通过“窗口 > 工作区”或状态行下拉列表切换。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no panel editor: split / join areas by their corners and keep layouts as workspaces.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有面板编辑器。请拖动编辑区角部拆分或合并编辑区，并将布局保存为工作区。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Look Through Selected / Undo View Change
entries.suggested_chinese: 通过选定对象观察 / 撤消视图更改

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no camera bookmarks: keep a camera per view (Panels > Look Through Selected) or step back with View > Undo View Change.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有摄影机书签。可为每个视图保留摄影机，通过“面板 > 通过选定对象观察”切换，或使用“视图 > 撤消视图变化”返回。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no 2D pan / zoom of the film back: move the camera's Shift X / Y (Attribute Editor > Film Offset).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 不支持片门的二维平移/缩放。可调整摄影机 Shift X / Y，即“属性编辑器 > 片门偏移”。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 摄影机视图边框（始终启用）

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's camera view always draws the render resolution frame (Maya's resolution gate; Maya's factory camera has it off, overscan 1.0): it can't be hidden. Gate Mask dims the outside (Blender passepartout).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 的摄影机视图始终显示渲染分辨率边框，即 Maya 的分辨率门，无法隐藏。Maya 默认摄影机关闭此边框，过扫描为 1.0；门遮罩使边框外变暗，对应 Blender 的外框遮罩。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 动作安全框/标题安全框

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no field chart: the safe areas (Safe Action / Safe Title) are the camera guides it draws.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有视场图表；其摄影机辅助线提供动作安全框和标题安全框。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 渲染属性 > 运动模糊

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's viewport doesn't preview motion blur: it is a render setting (EEVEE / Cycles Motion Blur).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 视口不预览运动模糊；运动模糊位于 EEVEE 或 Cycles 的渲染设置中。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 偏好设置 > 视口 > 抗锯齿

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's viewport anti-aliasing is a preference, not a per-view button (the kit doesn't change preferences).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 视口抗锯齿是偏好设置，不是逐视图按钮；本工具包不会修改偏好设置。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 大纲视图 / 选择 > 层次

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no hierarchy pick mode: pick roots in the Outliner, Select > Hierarchy takes the children.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有层次选择模式。可在大纲视图选择根对象，再用“选择 > 层次”选取其子对象。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no selection handles: pick the object itself.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有选择控制柄；请直接选择对象。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's simulations are modifiers on meshes (cloth, fluid, particles): pick them with the mesh / point types.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 模拟是网格上的修改器，包括布料、流体和粒子；请选择网格或点类型来选择它们。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender snaps to the face under the mouse (Face Project), not to the centre of the object behind it.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 通过面投射吸附到鼠标下的面，而不是其后方对象的中心。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no view planes: snap to the grid or to a vertex.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有视图平面吸附；可吸附到栅格或顶点。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's render layers are View Layers (top bar, View Layer properties), with collections for overrides.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 渲染层对应视图层，位于顶栏和视图层属性中；通过集合进行覆盖。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's viewport can't be paused: switch to Wireframe or hide heavy objects.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 视口无法暂停；可切换为线框或隐藏复杂对象以降低开销。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no HumanIK character controls: rig with armatures (Skeleton menu).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有 HumanIK 角色控制器；可通过“骨架”菜单使用骨架绑定。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no camera sequencer view time: bind scene cameras to timeline markers (Ctrl+B in the Timeline) or cut camera strips in the Video Sequencer.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有摄影机序列编辑器的视图时间。可在时间轴中用 Ctrl + B 将场景摄影机绑定到标记，或在视频序列编辑器中剪辑摄影机片段。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no 2D pan / zoom of the film back: move the camera's Shift X / Y (Attribute Editor > Film Offset) or zoom in the camera view (wheel).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 不支持片门的二维平移/缩放。可调整摄影机 Shift X / Y，即“属性编辑器 > 片门偏移”，或在摄影机视图中使用滚轮缩放。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 翻滚工具 / Alt + 鼠标左键

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no azimuth / elevation camera tool: tumble with Alt+LMB or the Tumble Tool.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有摄影机方位角/仰角工具；可通过 Alt+鼠标左键或翻滚工具旋转视图。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 行走工具 / 飞行工具

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no yaw-pitch tool: turn the camera in place with the Walk or Fly Tool.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有偏航俯仰工具；可使用步行或飞行工具原地转动摄影机。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender shades a whole view one way (Solid / Wireframe), not per selected object.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 对整个视图统一使用实体或线框着色，不能按选定对象分别指定。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender shades faces from the mesh normals in every view; there is no faceted display mode (Lighting > Use Flat Lighting is the nearest view setting).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 在所有视图中都按网格法线对面着色，没有分面显示模式；最接近的视图设置是“照明 > 使用平直照明”。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender shades faces from the mesh normals in every view; there is no per-object faceted display mode.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 在所有视图中按网格法线着色，不支持为单个对象指定分面显示模式。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's views have no points-only display mode: Wireframe is the nearest (Object Properties > Viewport Display > Display As shows one object as Bounds / Wire).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 视图没有仅点显示模式，最接近的是线框。在“对象属性 > 视口显示 > 显示为”中可将单个对象显示为边界框或线框。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender X-rays the whole view (X-Ray), not only the components being edited.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 的 X 射线作用于整个视图，而不只作用于正在编辑的组件。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender keeps the view's shading while you tumble (no wireframe fallback): nothing to switch.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 翻滚视图时保持原有着色，不会退回线框模式，因此没有相应开关。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender always draws anti-aliased wires (a preference: Viewport > Quality > Anti-Aliasing).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 始终绘制抗锯齿线框；可在“偏好设置 > 视口 > 质量 > 抗锯齿”中设置。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's viewport has no fog: the render's Mist pass (View Layer properties) gives depth fog.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 视口没有雾效果；视图层属性中的渲染“迷雾”通道可生成深度雾。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 使用全部灯光，并隐藏灯光（h）

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender lights a view with every visible scene light and has no per-view light list: hide the lights you don't want (h) or use light linking (Object Properties > Shading).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 使用所有可见场景灯光照亮视图，没有逐视图灯光列表。可按 h 隐藏不需要的灯光，或使用“对象属性 > 着色”中的灯光链接。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's views always light the scene (studio, flat or scene lights): Use Flat Lighting shows the plain colours.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 视图始终使用演播室、平直或场景灯光照明。“使用平直照明”显示未经灯光变化的颜色。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender always lights both sides of a face in the viewport (Backface Culling hides back faces).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 视口始终对面的两侧照明；背面剔除可隐藏背面。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 对象属性 > 可见性 > 阻隔

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender holdouts are a render setting per object / collection; views don't filter them.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 阻隔是逐对象或集合的渲染设置，视图不能按该类型过滤。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has one viewport renderer (Workbench / EEVEE), listed as Viewport 2.0 and the render engine.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 只有一套视口渲染显示机制，使用 Workbench 或 EEVEE，此处以“视口 2.0”和渲染引擎列出。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 渲染属性 > 立体视觉

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's stereo is a scene setting (Stereoscopy, Views) shown in a stereo window mode, not a panel type.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 的立体显示是场景设置，通过“立体视觉”和“视图”配置，并以立体窗口模式显示；它不是面板类型。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no camera sets: bind cameras to timeline markers to switch between them.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有摄影机集；可将摄影机绑定到时间轴标记来切换。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 大纲视图 / 节点编辑器

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no Hypergraph: hierarchy is in the Outliner, node networks in the Node Editor (Panels > Panel).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有超级图。大纲视图显示层次，节点编辑器显示节点网络，可通过“面板 > 面板”切换。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender saves layouts as workspaces (Windows > Workspaces, the Status Line drop-down).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 将布局保存为工作区，可通过“窗口 > 工作区”或状态行下拉列表切换。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no panel editor: split / join areas by their corners and keep layouts as workspaces.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有面板编辑器。请拖动编辑区角部拆分或合并编辑区，并将布局保存为工作区。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Look Through Selected / Undo View Change
entries.suggested_chinese: 通过选定对象观察 / 撤消视图更改

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no camera bookmarks: keep a camera per view (Panels > Look Through Selected) or step back with View > Undo View Change.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有摄影机书签。可为每个视图保留摄影机，通过“面板 > 通过选定对象观察”切换，或使用“视图 > 撤消视图变化”返回。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no 2D pan / zoom of the film back: move the camera's Shift X / Y (Attribute Editor > Film Offset).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 不支持片门的二维平移/缩放。可调整摄影机 Shift X / Y，即“属性编辑器 > 片门偏移”。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 摄影机视图边框（始终启用）

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's camera view always draws the render resolution frame (Maya's resolution gate; Maya's factory camera has it off, overscan 1.0): it can't be hidden. Gate Mask dims the outside (Blender passepartout).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 的摄影机视图始终显示渲染分辨率边框，即 Maya 的分辨率门，无法隐藏。Maya 默认摄影机关闭此边框，过扫描为 1.0；门遮罩使边框外变暗，对应 Blender 的外框遮罩。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 动作安全框/标题安全框

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no field chart: the safe areas (Safe Action / Safe Title) are the camera guides it draws.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有视场图表；其摄影机辅助线提供动作安全框和标题安全框。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 渲染属性 > 运动模糊

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's viewport doesn't preview motion blur: it is a render setting (EEVEE / Cycles Motion Blur).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 视口不预览运动模糊；运动模糊位于 EEVEE 或 Cycles 的渲染设置中。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 偏好设置 > 视口 > 抗锯齿

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's viewport anti-aliasing is a preference, not a per-view button (the kit doesn't change preferences).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 视口抗锯齿是偏好设置，不是逐视图按钮；本工具包不会修改偏好设置。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 大纲视图 / 选择 > 层次

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no hierarchy pick mode: pick roots in the Outliner, Select > Hierarchy takes the children.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有层次选择模式。可在大纲视图选择根对象，再用“选择 > 层次”选取其子对象。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no selection handles: pick the object itself.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有选择控制柄；请直接选择对象。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's simulations are modifiers on meshes (cloth, fluid, particles): pick them with the mesh / point types.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 模拟是网格上的修改器，包括布料、流体和粒子；请选择网格或点类型来选择它们。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender snaps to the face under the mouse (Face Project), not to the centre of the object behind it.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 通过面投射吸附到鼠标下的面，而不是其后方对象的中心。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no view planes: snap to the grid or to a vertex.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有视图平面吸附；可吸附到栅格或顶点。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's render layers are View Layers (top bar, View Layer properties), with collections for overrides.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 渲染层对应视图层，位于顶栏和视图层属性中；通过集合进行覆盖。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's viewport can't be paused: switch to Wireframe or hide heavy objects.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 视口无法暂停；可切换为线框或隐藏复杂对象以降低开销。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no HumanIK character controls: rig with armatures (Skeleton menu).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有 HumanIK 角色控制器；可通过“骨架”菜单使用骨架绑定。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender draws a curve's or surface's control points and control polygon (hull) only in Edit Mode, and always there: they can't be shown in Object Mode or hidden per view.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 仅在编辑模式下绘制曲线、曲面的控制点和控制多边形，且始终显示；无法在对象模式显示，也不能按视图单独隐藏。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no component metadata: store values as custom properties (Attribute Editor Extra Attributes) or mesh attributes.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有组件元数据。可将值保存为自定义属性，即属性编辑器的附加属性，或保存为网格属性。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's clip-based animation editor is the NLA Editor (Windows > Animation Editors).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 基于片段的动画编辑器是非线性动画编辑器，位于“窗口 > 动画编辑器”。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no component metadata: store values as custom properties (Attribute Editor Extra Attributes) or mesh attributes.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有组件元数据。可将值保存为自定义属性，即属性编辑器的附加属性，或保存为网格属性。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's clip-based animation editor is the NLA Editor (Windows > Animation Editors).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 基于片段的动画编辑器是非线性动画编辑器，位于“窗口 > 动画编辑器”。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no vertex-face component: per-corner values (normals, colours, UVs) are edited on the face corners through their tools.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有顶点面组件；逐面角的法线、颜色和 UV，需通过相应工具在面角上编辑。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender curves are edited by their control points only: there are no points on the curve to pick (Subdivide adds one).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 曲线只能编辑控制点，没有可直接选取的曲线点；细分可增加控制点。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender draws the control polygon but has no hull component: select its control points.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 会绘制控制多边形，但没有独立控制壳组件；请改为选择控制点。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender curves have no edit points: Bezier curves are edited by their knots and handles.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 曲线没有 Maya 编辑点；贝塞尔曲线通过控制点及控制柄编辑。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.translation_kind: 技术标识/符号/数据模板：保留

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender tools finish with Enter or a right-click: there is no tool to complete from this menu.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 工具通过 Enter 或鼠标右键结束；此菜单没有可额外完成的工具操作。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's pivot has no orientation handle: turn the pivot with a custom orientation (Orientation menu > Create).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 枢轴没有方向控制柄。可通过“方向菜单 > 创建”建立自定义方向，再旋转枢轴。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender can't set the vertex order from three picked vertices: Mesh > Sort Elements reorders them by a rule.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 不能根据三个选定顶点设置顶点顺序；“网格 > 排序元素”可按指定规则重新排序。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no tool that merges two clicked border edges: select both edges and use Merge (At Center) or Bridge.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有依次单击两条边界边后合并的工具。请选择两条边，再执行“合并到中心”或“桥接”。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's Subdivision Surface has no invisible faces: delete the faces or hide them (Display > Hide).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 细分曲面没有不可见面，可直接删除面，或使用“显示 > 隐藏”隐藏面。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender snaps to faces (Face Project / Face Nearest), not to their centres.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 吸附到面本身，即面投影或最近面，而不是面的中心。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender moves the selected components together while snapping (Snap With in the snapping popover); there is no separate keep-spacing switch.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 吸附时整体移动选定组件，可在吸附弹出面板的“吸附基点”中设置；没有独立的“保持间距”开关。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no live object axis: create an orientation from the object (Orientation menu > Create) and pick it.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有活动对象轴。可通过“方向菜单 > 创建”从对象创建变换方向，再选择该方向。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's custom axis is a saved orientation: Orientation menu > Create, from the selection.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 的自定义轴是保存的变换方向。可根据当前选择，通过“方向菜单 > 创建”生成。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender keeps saved orientations until you delete them: pick Object to go back to the default rotate axis.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 会一直保留已保存的方向，直到手动删除；选择“对象”即可恢复默认旋转轴。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no relationship editor layout: the Outliner and Properties sit beside the view in every workspace.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有关系编辑器布局；每个工作区中的大纲视图和属性编辑器位于视图旁。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's Time Slider is the Timeline area: drag its edge to hide it, or maximize the view (Ctrl+Space) for more room.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 的时间滑块是时间轴区域。可拖动区域边缘将其隐藏，或按 Ctrl + 空格键最大化视图以获得更多空间。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: The Range Slider is part of the Timeline header in Blender: it hides with the Timeline.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 范围滑块属于时间轴标题栏，会随时间轴一起隐藏。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no hierarchy select mode: click the object and use Select > Hierarchy (or the Outliner) to take its children.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有层次选择模式。请单击对象，再使用“选择 > 层次”或大纲视图选择其子对象。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's dynamics are modifiers and physics settings on ordinary objects, so they have no selection mask of their own.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 动力学是普通对象上的修改器和物理设置，因此没有独立的选择遮罩。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender always keeps vertex, edge or face picking on: switch with F9 / F10 / F11.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 始终保留顶点、边或面选择；使用 F9 / F10 / F11 切换。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no shelf button from a pick mask: right-click a select mode button > Add to Quick Favorites.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 不能从选择遮罩创建工具架按钮。可右键单击选择模式按钮，选择“添加到快速收藏夹”。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no vertex-face component: per-corner values (normals, colours, UVs) are edited on the face corners through their tools.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有顶点面组件；逐面角的法线、颜色和 UV，需通过相应工具在面角上编辑。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender curves are edited by their control points only: there are no points on the curve to pick (Subdivide adds one).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 曲线只能编辑控制点，没有可直接选取的曲线点；细分可增加控制点。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender draws the control polygon but has no hull component: select its control points.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 会绘制控制多边形，但没有独立控制壳组件；请改为选择控制点。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender curves have no edit points: Bezier curves are edited by their knots and handles.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 曲线没有 Maya 编辑点；贝塞尔曲线通过控制点及控制柄编辑。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender tools finish with Enter or a right-click: there is no tool to complete from this menu.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 工具通过 Enter 或鼠标右键结束；此菜单没有可额外完成的工具操作。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's pivot has no orientation handle: turn the pivot with a custom orientation (Orientation menu > Create).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 枢轴没有方向控制柄。可通过“方向菜单 > 创建”建立自定义方向，再旋转枢轴。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender can't set the vertex order from three picked vertices: Mesh > Sort Elements reorders them by a rule.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 不能根据三个选定顶点设置顶点顺序；“网格 > 排序元素”可按指定规则重新排序。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no tool that merges two clicked border edges: select both edges and use Merge (At Center) or Bridge.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有依次单击两条边界边后合并的工具。请选择两条边，再执行“合并到中心”或“桥接”。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's Subdivision Surface has no invisible faces: delete the faces or hide them (Display > Hide).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 细分曲面没有不可见面，可直接删除面，或使用“显示 > 隐藏”隐藏面。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender snaps to faces (Face Project / Face Nearest), not to their centres.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 吸附到面本身，即面投影或最近面，而不是面的中心。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender moves the selected components together while snapping (Snap With in the snapping popover); there is no separate keep-spacing switch.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 吸附时整体移动选定组件，可在吸附弹出面板的“吸附基点”中设置；没有独立的“保持间距”开关。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no live object axis: create an orientation from the object (Orientation menu > Create) and pick it.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有活动对象轴。可通过“方向菜单 > 创建”从对象创建变换方向，再选择该方向。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's custom axis is a saved orientation: Orientation menu > Create, from the selection.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 的自定义轴是保存的变换方向。可根据当前选择，通过“方向菜单 > 创建”生成。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender keeps saved orientations until you delete them: pick Object to go back to the default rotate axis.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 会一直保留已保存的方向，直到手动删除；选择“对象”即可恢复默认旋转轴。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no relationship editor layout: the Outliner and Properties sit beside the view in every workspace.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有关系编辑器布局；每个工作区中的大纲视图和属性编辑器位于视图旁。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's Time Slider is the Timeline area: drag its edge to hide it, or maximize the view (Ctrl+Space) for more room.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 的时间滑块是时间轴区域。可拖动区域边缘将其隐藏，或按 Ctrl + 空格键最大化视图以获得更多空间。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: The Range Slider is part of the Timeline header in Blender: it hides with the Timeline.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 范围滑块属于时间轴标题栏，会随时间轴一起隐藏。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no hierarchy select mode: click the object and use Select > Hierarchy (or the Outliner) to take its children.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有层次选择模式。请单击对象，再使用“选择 > 层次”或大纲视图选择其子对象。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's dynamics are modifiers and physics settings on ordinary objects, so they have no selection mask of their own.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 动力学是普通对象上的修改器和物理设置，因此没有独立的选择遮罩。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender always keeps vertex, edge or face picking on: switch with F9 / F10 / F11.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 始终保留顶点、边或面选择；使用 F9 / F10 / F11 切换。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no shelf button from a pick mask: right-click a select mode button > Add to Quick Favorites.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 不能从选择遮罩创建工具架按钮。可右键单击选择模式按钮，选择“添加到快速收藏夹”。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's history is the modifier stack, which has no upstream / downstream nodes to select or switch off: show / hide modifiers in Properties > Modifiers.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 历史由修改器堆栈表示，没有可供选择或关闭的上游、下游节点。请在“属性 > 修改器”中显示或隐藏修改器。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender picks this kind of component in the object's own edit mode (Tab), not through a pick mask: the mask only switches mesh vertex / edge / face picking.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 在对象自身的编辑模式中选择此类组件，而非通过选择遮罩；该遮罩仅切换网格的顶点、边、面选择。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender packs textures and sounds into the .blend instead of zipping the scene folder.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 将纹理和声音打包到 .blend 文件，而不是将场景文件夹压缩成 ZIP。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender writes each clip as an FBX take (an NLA strip while it writes); Maya's extra Take 001 and repeated clips in later clip files are left out.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 将每个片段写为一个 FBX 动画片段，写出时使用 NLA 片段；不写出 Maya 的额外 Take 001，也不在后续片段文件中重复写出之前的片段。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender plays the render output frames (Render > View Animation).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 通过“渲染 > 查看动画”播放渲染输出帧。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender removes unused materials (and other unused data) with File > Clean Up > Purge.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 通过“文件 > 清理 > 清除”移除未使用的材质及其他未使用数据。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender gives the selected objects the active object's mesh (Object > Link/Transfer Data).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 将活动对象的网格数据赋给其他选定对象，使用“对象 > 链接/传递数据”。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender mutes the IK constraints (Maya switches the IK solve off); on again unmutes them.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 通过禁用 IK 约束实现关闭 IK 求解；重新开启时恢复约束。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender mutes its drivers (Maya expressions); Set Driven Key curves keep working.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 会禁用驱动器，驱动器对应 Maya 表达式；设置驱动关键帧所用的曲线仍正常工作。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender switches the colliders' Collision off.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 关闭碰撞体的碰撞功能。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender switches the scene's Rigid Body World off.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 关闭场景的刚体世界。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no nucleus constraints: rigid body constraints switch off with Rigid Bodies.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有 nucleus 约束；关闭刚体时，会同时关闭刚体约束。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no NURBS surface stitching to switch off.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有可供关闭的 NURBS 曲面缝合功能。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no per-node manipulators: the object's Default Object Manipulator tool, else the Transform tool.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有逐节点操纵器。使用对象的默认对象操纵器工具，否则使用变换工具。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender draws no align icons on the bounding box: pick the axis and Min / Mid / Max in a popup; the last selected object stays.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 不在边界框上绘制对齐图标。请在弹出窗口中选择轴及最小值、中间值或最大值；最后选定对象保持不动。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender applies the smooth preview Subsurf to the base mesh: deformers before it (skin, lattice) keep working on the denser mesh.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 将平滑预览的细分曲面应用到基础网格。位于它之前的蒙皮、晶格等变形器仍会在更密的网格上工作。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender playback always loops: Continuous is already on.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 始终循环播放，持续循环已启用。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender: same as h (selected objects shown / hidden).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 中与 h 相同，显示或隐藏选定对象。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's cluster1 is a Hook modifier driven by cluster1Handle; its weights are the vertex group cluster1.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 中的 cluster1 是由 cluster1Handle 驱动的钩挂修改器，其权重保存在 cluster1 顶点组中。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no sine deformer: sine1 is a Wave modifier along X around sine1Handle (Blender's wave shape, no bounds).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有正弦变形器。插件用沿 sine1Handle 局部 X 轴作用的波浪修改器 sine1 替代；采用 Blender 波形，不支持边界限制。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender: ffd1Lattice drives the Lattice modifier ffd1; the Hook ffd1Base in front of it carries the points when the lattice object moves (Maya's base lattice).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 中，ffd1Lattice 驱动晶格修改器 ffd1；位于其前方的钩挂修改器 ffd1Base 在晶格对象移动时带动控制点，对应 Maya 的基础晶格。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender: wrap1 is a Surface Deform modifier bound to the influence (shape), the Hook wrap1Base after it follows the influence's transform.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 中，wrap1 是绑定到影响对象形状的曲面变形修改器；其后的钩挂修改器 wrap1Base 跟随影响对象的变换。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender: proximityWrap1 is a Surface Deform modifier bound to the driver (Maya's Surface wrap mode).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 中，proximityWrap1 是绑定到驱动对象的曲面变形修改器，对应 Maya 的曲面包裹模式。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no wire deformer: wire1 is a Geometry Nodes modifier with Maya's wire rule (dropoff, rotation, dropoff locators); select the objects, then the curve.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有线变形器。插件用几何节点修改器 wire1 实现 Maya 的线变形规则，包括衰减、旋转和衰减定位器。先选择对象，再选择曲线。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's kit wire has no holder curves: limit the wire with its Dropoff distance or paint its weights (Paint Weights > Wire).
entries.suggested_chinese: 插件的线变形器不支持限制曲线。可通过衰减距离限制作用范围，或在“绘制权重 > 线”中绘制权重。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender hooks the selected control point to locator1 (Maya fits the curve through the point by least squares).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 将选定控制点钩挂到 locator1；Maya 则通过最小二乘拟合使曲线经过该点。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no wrinkle deformer: sculpt the wrinkles (Crease brush) or use a Displace modifier (Deform > Texture).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有褶皱变形器。可用折痕笔刷雕刻褶皱，或使用“变形 > 纹理”对应的置换修改器。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender: select the object, then vertices of the mesh, Vertex Parent (Ctrl+P).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 中先选择对象，再选择网格顶点，执行“顶点父级”（Ctrl+P）。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender draws toon outlines with a Line Art Grease Pencil object.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 使用带线条画效果的蜡笔对象绘制卡通轮廓线。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender stereo = a camera with Render > Stereoscopy (Views) on, no stereo rig.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 立体显示使用摄影机并启用“渲染 > 立体视觉（视图）”，没有独立立体绑定。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no Time Editor: the sound becomes a Video Sequencer strip.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有时间编辑器；声音会成为视频序列编辑器中的音频片段。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's manual opens in the web browser.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 手册在网页浏览器中打开。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's About shows its version (Maya Workflow Kit is an extension).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender“关于”显示 Blender 版本；Maya Workflow Kit 是扩展。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no game-engine live links: export FBX (Unity / Unreal read it).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有游戏引擎实时链接；请导出 FBX，再由 Unity 或 Unreal 读取。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's Statistics overlay shows the object and selection counts.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 的统计叠加层显示对象数与选定项目数。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's Shrinkwrap has no inner object: Projection Toward Inner Object projects along the inverted normals.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 收缩包裹没有内部对象；“朝内部对象投影”通过沿反向法线投影实现。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender paints the deformer's vertex group in Weight Paint mode (the group of the deformer's name).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 在权重绘制模式中绘制变形器对应的顶点组，顶点组名称与变形器名称一致。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender sticks an object to a surface with a Shrinkwrap constraint (Nearest Surface Point).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 通过收缩包裹约束的“最近曲面点”模式将对象贴到曲面。

entries.english: Blender writes / reads geometry caches as Alembic (.abc) files, played by a Mesh Sequence Cache modifier.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 以 Alembic（.abc）格式读写几何体缓存，并通过网格序列缓存修改器播放。

entries.english: Blender has no GPU cache node: GPU caches are Alembic files.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有 GPU 缓存节点；GPU 缓存使用 Alembic 文件。

entries.english: Blender's colours come from the theme: Preferences > Themes (install a Maya-like theme there if you want Maya's colours).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 的颜色由主题决定，可在“偏好设置 > 主题”中调整；如需 Maya 风格颜色，可自行安装相应主题。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's Graph Editor doesn't highlight the curve under the mouse: the picked curve is drawn brighter once selected.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 曲线图编辑器不会高亮鼠标下方未选曲线；选中后才会以更亮的颜色绘制。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's Dope Sheet has no scene summary, channel sets or key value display: a key's value shows in the Graph Editor.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 摄影表没有场景汇总、通道集或关键帧数值显示；可在曲线图编辑器查看关键帧的值。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender resets editors with File > Defaults > Load Factory Settings.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 通过“文件 > 默认 > 加载出厂设置”重置编辑器。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's UV Editor shows one image, so there is no per-image face filter: Select Linked, Overlapping and the face filters (Connected / Contained Faces) are there.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender UV 编辑器一次显示一张图像，因此没有逐图像的面过滤器；可使用选择相连元素、重叠组件，以及相连面/完全包含的面过滤。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's UV tools are Select, Move / Rotate / Scale, Rip and the Grab / Relax / Pinch sculpt brushes.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender UV 工具有选择、移动、旋转、缩放、撕裂，以及抓取、松弛、捏拢雕刻笔刷。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's UV Editor has no such display option: see its Overlays popover and View menu.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender UV 编辑器没有此显示选项，请查看“叠加层”弹出面板和“视图”菜单。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 添加选定对象 / 移除选定对象

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no saved quick-select sets to load into the isolate view: build it with Add Selected / Remove Selected (Ctrl+1 isolates the selection).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有可加载到隔离视图的已保存快速选择集。请使用“添加选定对象 / 移除选定对象”建立隔离内容；Ctrl + 1 隔离当前选择。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no UV symmetrize: mirror the UVs (Modify > Flip) and weld them (Match UVs), or unwrap with the mesh's symmetry (Mirror modifier with Mirror U).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有 UV 对称化。可先通过“修改 > 翻转”镜像 UV，再用“匹配 UV”焊接；或使用启用“镜像 U”的镜像修改器，按网格对称性展开。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no UV symmetrize brush: mirror the UVs (Modify > Flip) and weld them (Match UVs), or unwrap with the mesh's symmetry (Mirror modifier with Mirror U).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有 UV 对称化笔刷。可使用“修改 > 翻转”镜像 UV，再通过“匹配 UV”焊接；也可在镜像修改器中启用镜像 U，随网格对称展开。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender shows one image (header image field): no dimming, PSD networks, bake preview or pixel ruler.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 通过标题栏图像字段显示单张图像，不提供淡化、PSD 网络、烘焙预览或像素标尺。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender lists the images in the header image field.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 在标题栏的图像字段中列出图像。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's UV sets are UV Maps (Object Data Properties > UV Maps: rename there; no per-instance sharing).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 的 UV 集对应 UV 贴图，可在“对象数据属性 > UV 贴图”中重命名；不支持按实例共享。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender doesn't highlight new menu items: Help > What's New lists them.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 不高亮新增菜单项；可在“帮助 > 新增功能”中查看。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's panels have no settings reset: fold the sections by hand.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 面板不支持重置此类设置；请手动折叠各分区。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has one auto tangent (Auto Clamped): Maya's Ease / Mix / Custom weights aren't there.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 仅有一种自动切线，即自动钳制，不提供 Maya 的缓动、混合或自定义权重方式。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender picks keys on every curve it shows: hide the unselected curves (Shift+H) to pick only on the selected ones.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 可选取全部显示曲线上的关键帧。如需仅选取选定曲线的关键帧，可按 Shift+H 隐藏其他曲线。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's channel list has no channel sets.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 通道列表不支持通道集。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 按 G 后输入数值

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender moves the selected keys by a typed amount: G, then the amount, then Enter.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 可按输入的数值移动选定关键帧：按 G，输入移动量，再按 Enter。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender clamps a curve's values with a Limits F-Curve modifier (Sidebar > Modifiers), not by changing the keys.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 通过曲线图编辑器侧栏中的“限制”函数曲线修改器钳制数值，不直接修改关键帧。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender moves the selected keys by a typed number of frames: G, then the amount, then Enter.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 可按输入帧数移动选定关键帧：按 G，输入帧数，再按 Enter。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's Dope Sheet always moves the key under the mouse when you drag it: no tool to pick.
entries.suggested_chinese: 在 Blender 摄影表中拖动时，始终移动鼠标下的关键帧，不需要另选工具。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no Trax clip time to switch: a strip's keys show at the strip's time while you tweak the strip in the NLA Editor (Tab).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有可切换的 Trax 片段时间。在 NLA 编辑器中按 Tab 微调片段时，其关键帧按该片段的时间显示。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender draws no curve for a value that isn't keyed: driver curves are in the Graph Editor's Drivers mode (header mode menu).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 不会为未设置关键帧的值绘制曲线。驱动器曲线位于曲线图编辑器的“驱动器”模式，可通过标题栏模式菜单切换。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender always darkens the frames outside the playback range in the Graph Editor: the shades can't be turned off.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 始终在曲线图编辑器中将播放范围之外的帧显示为较暗背景，此阴影无法关闭。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's range shades can't be dragged, so there is nothing to lock: set the range on the Range Slider.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 的范围遮罩不能拖动，因此没有可锁定的拖动行为；请在范围滑块中设置范围。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender highlights the selected keys and their curve, not the curve segment a key or tangent affects.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 高亮显示选定关键帧及其所在曲线，不单独高亮关键帧或切线影响的曲线段。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender always draws the keys of the curves it shows; Keys > Active Only (Preferences > Animation > Only Selected Curve Keyframes) is the closest.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 始终绘制当前显示曲线的关键帧。最接近的设置是“关键帧 > 仅活动”，对应“偏好设置 > 动画 > 仅选定曲线的关键帧”。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has one row for the Maya Graph Editor toolbar: there is no simple variant.
entries.suggested_chinese: 本插件的 Maya 曲线图编辑器工具栏仅有单行完整形式，没有简化形式。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender keeps no history of Graph Editor views: frame again with View > Frame All or Frame Selection.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 不保留曲线图编辑器的视图历史；可用“视图 > 框显全部”或“框显选择”重新定位。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender draws Graph Editor keys without state marks; key types (breakdown, ...) show in the Dope Sheet.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 曲线图编辑器的关键帧不显示状态标记；分解关键帧等类型在摄影表中显示。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's Graph Editor time ruler is always at the top (the scrubbing area), Maya's factory placement.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 曲线图编辑器的时间标尺始终位于顶部的时间拖动区域，与 Maya 默认位置一致。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's clips are NLA strips: they are listed in the NLA Editor, not in this list.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 动画片段是 NLA 片段，列于 NLA 编辑器中，不在此列表中显示。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender shares shading networks by appending or linking materials from another .blend (File > Append), not by exporting a network file.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 通过“文件 > 追加”从其他 .blend 文件追加或链接材质，以共享着色网络，而不是导出独立网络文件。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no such Hypershade command: PSD networks, texture conversion and swatch rendering aren't there; edit the network in the Shader Editor.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有此 Hypershade 命令，不提供 PSD 网络、纹理转换或色样渲染；请在着色器编辑器中编辑节点网络。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no node of this type to delete: use the Outliner (Blender File view) or File > Clean Up > Purge.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有此类独立节点可删除。请使用大纲视图的“Blender 文件”模式，或“文件 > 清理 > 清除孤立数据”。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender selects materials and textures in the Outliner's Blender File view, not in the scene.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 在大纲视图的“Blender 文件”模式中选择材质和纹理，而不是在场景中选择。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender copies a material with its whole node tree (Duplicate / Shading Network).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 复制材质时同时复制其完整节点树，对应“复制 / 着色网络”。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.suggested_chinese: 在着色器编辑器中按 Shift + A

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no node of this Maya type: add the closest node with Shift+A in the Shader Editor.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有此 Maya 节点类型。请在着色器编辑器中按 Shift+A 添加最接近的节点。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no game, hair-tube, ocean or USD Preview shader of this kind: start from a Standard Surface (Principled BSDF).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有此类游戏、毛发管、海洋或 USD Preview 着色器。可从标准曲面，即原理化 BSDF 材质开始制作。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's volumes are shaders on the material's Volume output (Principled Volume) or the World's: add them with Shift+A > Volume.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 体积效果由连接到材质或世界“体积”输出的着色器实现，例如原理化体积；可通过 Shift+A > 体积添加。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's image planes are made in the 3D View (Create > Free Image Plane).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 图像平面在 3D 视图中创建，使用“创建 > 自由图像平面”。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's render passes are View Layer passes (View Layer Properties > Passes).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 渲染通道是视图层通道，位于“视图层属性 > 通道”。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender makes glow in the compositor (Glare node).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 通过合成器的“眩光”节点制作辉光。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's particles feed shaders through the Particle Info / Attribute nodes.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 粒子通过粒子信息或属性节点向着色器提供数据。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender switches between inputs with Mix nodes (or Geometry Nodes Switch).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 通过混合节点或几何节点的切换节点，在输入之间切换。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender materials always have their output node; textures get their own Mapping node.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 材质始终具有输出节点；纹理各自使用映射节点。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's Shader Editor has one graph per material: no Hypershade tabs (use node groups or another workspace).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 着色器编辑器为每个材质显示一个节点图，没有 Hypershade 选项卡；可使用节点组或其他工作区。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender shows the whole node tree of the material: there is no partial graph to build.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 显示材质的完整节点树，不支持构建局部图。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no such Hypershade panel: the material preview is in the Properties Material tab.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有此 Hypershade 面板；材质预览位于属性编辑区的材质选项卡。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's Shader Editor has no such option (see Preferences > Editing / Interface).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 着色器编辑器没有此选项；请查看“偏好设置 > 编辑/界面”。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no project image directory: type the folder in the Common tab's Path field.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有项目图像目录设置；请在“公用”选项卡的路径字段中输入文件夹。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's render presets are the Format panel preset menu (Output Properties); Maya's AOV / user presets aren't there.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 渲染预设位于“输出属性 > 格式”面板的预设菜单中，不提供 Maya AOV 或用户预设。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender sources a script by opening it and running it (Text > Run Script) and saves one text at a time; shelf buttons from scripts aren't there.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 通过打开脚本并执行“文本 > 运行脚本”加载脚本，一次只能保存一个文本；不提供从脚本生成工具架按钮的功能。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's Text Editor has no such option (see its View menu and Preferences > Editing > Text Editor).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 文本编辑器没有此选项。请查看其“视图”菜单及“偏好设置 > 编辑 > 文本编辑器”。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's script tabs are texts: rename one in the Text Editor header's name field.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 脚本选项卡对应文本数据块；可在文本编辑器标题栏的名称字段中重命名。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.translation_kind: 技术标识/符号/数据模板：保留

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no help on a selected command: see the Python API reference (Help > Python Command Reference).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 不提供所选命令的专属帮助。请参阅“帮助 > Python 命令参考”中的 Python API 文档。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender can't write into a linked file from here: open the referenced .blend, make the change there and save it (Reload shows it).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 无法从此处写入链接文件。请打开被引用的 .blend 文件，在其中修改并保存，再重新加载引用以显示更改。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender drops an override whose source data is gone: there are no unknown edits to list.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 会移除源数据已不存在的覆盖，因此没有可列出的未知引用编辑。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender has no reference proxies: use Replace Reference to switch the file (its edits are applied again by name).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 没有引用代理。可用“替换引用”切换文件，并按名称重新应用编辑。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender keeps no reference view sets: the Outliner's Blender File view lists every linked file.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 不保存引用视图集；大纲视图的“Blender 文件”模式会列出全部链接文件。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender's panel layout can't right-justify a label row.
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 面板布局不能将标签行右对齐。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: The table shows the mesh data names: Blender has no DAG path or namespace to add.
entries.suggested_chinese: 表格显示网格数据名称；Blender 没有可附加的 DAG 路径或命名空间。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender lists vertex groups in their own order: the columns follow it (Maya's influence order).
entries.suggested_chinese: Blender 按顶点组自身顺序排列列表，表格列随该顺序排列，对应 Maya 的影响对象顺序。

entries.category: 界面数据及自绘漏项复核
界面数据及自绘漏项复核
entries.english: Blender fields show 3 decimals here (Maya's factory precision); type more digits in a cell to set them.
entries.suggested_chinese: 此处 Blender 字段显示 3 位小数，与 Maya 默认精度一致；在单元格中输入更多位数仍可保存。
